jobs.title: Designer 60% -100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich‑Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Designer to strengthen our Interrupter Development team within High Voltage Circuit Breaker development. In this role, you will contribute to product design and development activities within our CAD\/PLM landscape for ongoing R&D projects. The position is part of the Interrupter Development team and works closely with the responsible R&D engineers within product development projects. You will be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and quality of 3D\/2D model data for assigned components and assemblies, supporting virtual product development from prototype phase to serial production. Are you looking for technical challenges in a fast‑paced development environment? Do you quickly grasp technical topics and enjoy working through different viewpoints to reach robust technical solutions? Do you like solving complex design tasks in close collaboration with experienced engineers? Then this position offers the right opportunity for you. Join our team and contribute to the development of high‑quality high‑voltage products in an international working environment in Zurich. How you'll make an impact   Take responsibility for the 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM implementation from concept design to series production within product development projects on high voltage switching devices Create, modify and analyze the design of selected components and assemblies of switching devices in close collaboration with R&D Engineers, and collaborate and support other project stakeholders, such as supply chain and product care Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CAD\/PLM\/SAP related processes and activities and drive the overall model quality Your background   Successfully completed apprenticeship as Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent know-how in CAD\/PLM systems, ideally PTC CREO and PTC Windchill Good Knowledge in SAP\/Office High expectations on quality of work in all regards Independent, proactive and goal-oriented personality Practically oriented and hands-on way of working Team-player, committed, willing to learn Good command of German both written and spoken

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità per la nostra Business Unit High Tension Products a Zurigo-Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un progettista R&D per rafforzare il nostro team di sviluppo interruttori all'interno dello sviluppo di High Tension Circuit Breaker. In questo ruolo, contribuirai alle attività di progettazione e sviluppo dei prodotti nel nostro paesaggio CAD\/PLM per i progetti R&D in corso. La posizione fa parte del team Interrupter Development e lavora a stretto contatto con i responsabili ingegneri R&D all'interno di progetti di sviluppo dei prodotti. Sarete responsabili per la creazione, la manutenzione e la qualità dei dati del modello 3D\/2D per componenti e assemblaggi assegnati, supportando lo sviluppo del prodotto virtuale dalla fase del prototipo alla produzione seriale. Stai cercando sfide tecniche in un ambiente di sviluppo veloce? Capisci rapidamente gli argomenti tecnici e ti godi di lavorare attraverso diversi punti di vista per raggiungere soluzioni tecniche robuste? Ti piace risolvere complessi compiti di progettazione in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri esperti? Poi questa posizione offre la giusta opportunità per voi. Unisciti al nostro team e contribuisci allo sviluppo di prodotti di alta qualità ad alta tensione in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale a Zurigo. Assumere la responsabilità per l'implementazione 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM dal design del concetto alla produzione di serie all'interno di progetti di sviluppo di prodotti su dispositivi di commutazione ad alta tensione Creare, modificare e analizzare il design di componenti e assemblaggi selezionati di dispositivi di commutazione in stretta collaborazione con gli ingegneri R&D, e collaborare e supportare altri stakeholder di progetto, come la catena di fornitura e la cura del prodotto

descriptionByLocale.de: Für unsere Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zürich‐Oerlikon suchen wir einen R&D Designer, um unser Interrupter Development Team innerhalb der High Voltage Circuit Breaker Entwicklung zu stärken. In dieser Rolle werden Sie zur Produktgestaltung und -entwicklung in unserer CAD/PLM-Landschaft für laufende FuE-Projekte beitragen. Die Position ist Teil des Interrupter Development Teams und arbeitet eng mit den verantwortlichen FuE-Ingenieuren in Produktentwicklungsprojekten zusammen. Sie sind für die Erstellung, Wartung und Qualität von 3D\/2D Modelldaten für zugeordnete Komponenten und Baugruppen verantwortlich und unterstützen die virtuelle Produktentwicklung von der Prototypphase bis zur Serienfertigung. Suchen Sie technische Herausforderungen in einem schnelllebigen Entwicklungsumfeld? Greifen Sie schnell technische Themen und genießen Sie die Arbeit durch verschiedene Gesichtspunkte, um robuste technische Lösungen zu erreichen? Mögen Sie komplexe Designaufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren lösen? Dann bietet diese Position die richtige Gelegenheit für Sie. Begleiten Sie unser Team und tragen Sie zur Entwicklung hochwertiger Hochspannungsprodukte in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld in Zürich bei. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Verantwortung für die 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM-Implementierung von Konzeptdesign zu Serienproduktion innerhalb von Produktentwicklungsprojekten an Hochspannungsschaltgeräten Erstelle, Modifizierung und Analyse der Gestaltung ausgewählter Komponenten und Baugruppen von Schaltgeräten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit R&D Engineers und kooperiere und unterstütze andere Projektverantwortliche, wie z.B. Lieferkette und Produktpflege
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Pour notre Business Unit High Voltage Products à Zurich-Oerlikon, nous cherchons un concepteur de R & D pour renforcer notre équipe de développement Interrupteur dans le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez aux activités de conception et de développement de produits dans notre paysage CAD\/PLM pour les projets de R-D en cours. Le poste fait partie de l'équipe de développement d'interruption et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs responsables de la R-D dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la maintenance et de la qualité des données du modèle 3D\/2D pour les composants et assemblages assignés, soutenant le développement de produits virtuels de la phase prototype à la production en série. Vous recherchez des défis techniques dans un environnement de développement rapide? Saisissez-vous rapidement les sujets techniques et profitez de travailler à travers différents points de vue pour atteindre des solutions techniques robustes? Vous aimez résoudre des tâches de conception complexes en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs expérimentés ? Ensuite, ce poste vous offre la bonne occasion. Rejoignez notre équipe et contribuez au développement de produits haute tension de haute qualité dans un environnement de travail international à Zurich. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Prendre la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM de la conception de concepts à la production en série dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits sur des appareils de commutation haute tension Créer, modifier et analyser la conception de composants et d'ensembles sélectionnés de dispositifs de commutation en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs de R&D, et collaborer et appuyer d'autres intervenants du projet, tels que la chaîne d'approvisionnement et le soin des produits Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et activités liés à la CAO\/PLM\/SAP et conduire la qualité globale du modèle Votre expérience Apprentissage réussi en tant que Konstrukteur\/In EFZ Excellent savoir-faire en systèmes CAO\/PLM, idéalement PTC CREO et PTC Windchill Bonne connaissance en SAP\/Office Grandes attentes en matière de qualité de travail en tous points Personnalité indépendante, proactive et orientée vers l'objectif Pratiquement orientée et pratique du travail Joueur d'équipe, engagé, prêt à apprendre Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand à la fois écrite et parlée

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician Power Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Transformers After Sales team in Zürich, Switzerland, and play a hands-on role in powering the nation! As a key player, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining and enhancing the reliability and longevity of power transformers all across Switzerland. In this role, you'll directly impact the stability of the Swiss electrical grid and get the unique opportunity to work alongside leading companies in the Swiss energy sector.  Every day, you'll tackle new technical challenges, ensure the safe and high-quality execution of critical fieldwork, and proudly represent Hitachi Energy's reputation for technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Step into a position where your expertise truly makes a difference!    How you´ll make an impact Apply and enforce Hitachi Energy safety standards during all onsite operations.  Perform installations, preventive and corrective maintenance, inspections, and overhauls on power transformers in accordance with internal procedures.  Plan, coordinate and optimize field interventions to ensure efficiency and quality.  Identify potential service opportunities and communicate them to the Sales team.  Collaborate closely with customers, project teams, suppliers and other stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication.  Actively contribute to continuous improvement within the service organization.  Complete all reports, documentation and quality records accurately in the internal tracking system.    Your background   Federal Certificate of Competence (CFC) in mechanics, industrial maintenance, electromechanics, or a related field (e.g., locksmith, mechanic, polymechanic, automation technician).  At least 2 years of relevant field experience is considered an asset.  Willingness to travel across Switzerland for extended periods (minimum 1 week) and occasionally work in 2×8 shifts.  Strong sense of responsibility and high awareness of safety requirements.  Valid Category B driver's licence.  Good command of German, with English and French as additional working languages.    What would be a plus   Knowledge of electrical wiring and electrical diagrams  Welding skills  Motivation to follow internal training on transformer assembly and field interventions, including advanced training in Hitachi Energy factories  More about us Exciting and varied responsibilities with plenty of room for autonomy and creativity Attractive opportunities for further training and personal development Interesting and diverse tasks and projects – including international assignments A well ‑ coordinated and dynamic team An open and supportive company culture An attractive compensation package including fixed salary, travel and meal allowances, as well as the opportunity to have a say in accommodation arrangements

titleByLocale.fr: Transformateurs de puissance pour techniciens du Service mobile (f/m/j)

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro dinamico Transformers After Sales team di Zurigo, Svizzera, e gioca un ruolo pratico nel potere della nazione! Come giocatore chiave, sarete in prima linea nel mantenere e migliorare l'affidabilità e la longevità dei trasformatori di potenza in tutta la Svizzera. In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Ogni giorno affronterai nuove sfide tecniche, garantirai l'esecuzione sicura e di alta qualità del lavoro sul campo critico e rappresenterai con orgoglio la reputazione di Hitachi Energy per l'eccellenza tecnica e la soddisfazione del cliente. Entra in una posizione in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero la differenza! Applicare e far rispettare gli standard di sicurezza Hitachi Energy durante tutte le operazioni in loco. Eseguire installazioni, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, ispezioni e revisioni sui trasformatori di potenza in conformità con le procedure interne. Pianificare, coordinare e ottimizzare gli interventi sul campo per garantire efficienza e qualità. Identificare potenziali opportunità di servizio e comunicarle al team Vendite. Collabora a stretto contatto con clienti, team di progetto, fornitori e altri stakeholder, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e tempestiva. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. Conoscenza dei cablaggi elettrici e diagrammi elettrici Capacità di saldatura Motivazione per seguire la formazione interna sull'assemblaggio dei trasformatori e gli interventi sul campo, inclusa la formazione avanzata nelle fabbriche Hitachi Energy Maggiori informazioni su di noi Responsabilità emozionanti e varie con ampio spazio per autonomia e creatività Opportunità interessanti per ulteriori formazione e sviluppo personale Compiti e progetti interessanti e diversi – tra cui incarichi internazionali Un team ben coordinato e dinamico Una cultura aziendale aperta e di supporto Un pacchetto di compensazione attraente, tra cui stipendio fisso, spese di viaggio e di pasto, così come l'opportunità di avere una voce nel regime di alloggio

descriptionByLocale.de:
Nehmen Sie an unseren dynamischen Transformatoren teil Nach dem Vertriebsteam in Zürich, Schweiz, und spielen Sie eine Hand-on-Rolle bei der Macht der Nation! Als Schlüsselakteur sind Sie an der Spitze der Aufrechterhaltung und Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit und Langlebigkeit von Stromwandlern in der ganzen Schweiz. In dieser Rolle werden Sie die Stabilität des Schweizer Stromnetzes direkt beeinflussen und die einzigartige Möglichkeit erhalten, gemeinsam mit führenden Unternehmen im Schweizer Energiesektor zu arbeiten. Jeden Tag werden Sie neue technische Herausforderungen angehen, die sichere und qualitativ hochwertige Ausführung von kritischen Feldarbeiten sicherstellen und stolz den Ruf von Hitachi Energy für technische Exzellenz und Kundenzufriedenheit vertreten. Treten Sie in eine Position, in der Ihr Know-how wirklich einen Unterschied macht! Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Anwendung und Durchsetzung von Hitachi Energy Sicherheitsstandards während aller Vor-Ort-Betriebe. Durchführung von Installationen, vorbeugenden und korrigierenden Wartungen, Inspektionen und Überholungen an Leistungstransformatoren nach internen Verfahren. Planen, koordinieren und optimieren Sie Feldeingriffe, um Effizienz und Qualität zu gewährleisten. Identifizieren Sie potenzielle Service-Möglichkeiten und kommunizieren Sie sie dem Sales-Team. Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Projektteams, Lieferanten und anderen Akteuren, um eine klare und zeitnahe Kommunikation zu gewährleisten. Aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung innerhalb der Service-Organisation beitragen. Vervollständigen Sie alle Berichte, Dokumentationen und Qualitätsaufzeichnungen genau im internen Trackingsystem. Ihr Hintergrund Federal Certificate of Competence (CFC) in Mechanik, industrielle Wartung, Elektromechanik oder einem verwandten Bereich (z.B. Schlosser, Mechaniker, Polymechaniker, Automatisierungstechniker). Mindestens 2 Jahre relevanter Felderfahrung wird als Asset betrachtet. Reisebereitschaft in die Schweiz für längere Zeiträume (mindestens 1 Woche) und gelegentlich in 2×8 Schichten. Starkes Verantwortungsgefühl und hohes Bewusstsein für Sicherheitsanforderungen. Gültig Kategorie B Führerschein. Gutes Kommando auf Deutsch, mit Englisch und Französisch als zusätzliche Arbeitssprachen. Was wäre ein Plus Kenntnisse der elektrischen Verdrahtung und elektrischen Diagramme Schweißen Fähigkeiten Motivation zur internen Ausbildung auf Transformator-Montage- und Feldeingriffe zu folgen, einschließlich Fortbildung in Hitachi Energiefabriken Mehr über uns Spannende und vielfältige

• Aufgaben und Projekte – darunter internationale
• Aufgaben Ein gut koordiniertes und dynamisches Team Ein offenes und unterstützendes Unternehmenskultur Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket einschließlich Festgehalt, Reise- und Mahlzeitenzulagen sowie die Möglichkeit, bei Unterkunftsvereinbarungen zu sprechen
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez notre dynamique équipe Transformers After Sales à Zurich, en Suisse, et jouez un rôle pratique dans le pouvoir de la nation ! En tant que joueur clé, vous serez à l'avant-garde du maintien et de l'amélioration de la fiabilité et de la longévité des transformateurs de puissance partout en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez un impact direct sur la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez l'occasion unique de travailler avec des entreprises de premier plan du secteur énergétique suisse. Chaque jour, vous vous attaquerez à de nouveaux défis techniques, assurerez une exécution sûre et de haute qualité des travaux critiques sur le terrain et représenterez fièrement la réputation d'Hitachi Energy pour son excellence technique et sa satisfaction de la clientèle. Entrez dans une position où votre expertise fait vraiment une différence! Comment vous ferez un impact Appliquer et appliquer les normes de sécurité de l'énergie Hitachi pendant toutes les opérations sur place. Effectuer les installations, l'entretien préventif et correctif, les inspections et les révisions des transformateurs de puissance conformément aux procédures internes. Planifier, coordonner et optimiser les interventions sur le terrain pour assurer l'efficacité et la qualité. Identifier les possibilités de service et les communiquer à l'équipe des ventes. Collaborer étroitement avec les clients, les équipes de projet, les fournisseurs et les autres intervenants, en assurant une communication claire et opportune. Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation de services. Remplir avec précision tous les rapports, la documentation et les dossiers de qualité dans le système de suivi interne. Vos antécédents Certificat fédéral de compétence (CFC) en mécanique, entretien industriel, électromécanique ou dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., serrurier, mécanicien, polymécanique, technicien en automatisation). Au moins deux années d'expérience sur le terrain sont considérées comme un atout. Volonté de voyager à travers la Suisse pendant de longues périodes (minimum 1 semaine) et de travailler occasionnellement en 2×8. Un fort sens des responsabilités et une grande sensibilisation aux exigences de sécurité. Permis de conduire de catégorie B valide. Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand, l'anglais et le français étant des langues de travail supplémentaires. Ce qui serait un plus Connaissance du câblage électrique et des diagrammes électriques Aptitudes au soudage Motivation à suivre une formation interne sur l'assemblage des transformateurs et les interventions sur le terrain, y compris une formation avancée dans les usines d'Hitachi Énergie Plus sur nous Des responsabilités passionnantes et variées avec beaucoup de place pour l'autonomie et la créativité Des possibilités intéressantes pour la formation continue et le développement personnel Des tâches et des projets intéressants et variés – y compris des missions internationales Une équipe bien coordonnée et dynamique Une culture d'entreprise ouverte et solidaire Un ensemble de rémunérations attrayant comprenant un salaire fixe, des indemnités de voyage et de repas, ainsi que la possibilité d'avoir voix au chapitre dans les arrangements d'hébergement

descriptionByLocale.it: Come operatore di macchine (w\/m\/d), siete un membro prezioso della nostra produzione e contribuire direttamente alla qualità dei nostri prodotti con la vostra comprensione tecnica e un'attenta operazione. descriptionByLocale.en: About the position As a Machine Operator (w\/m\/d), you are a valuable member of our production and contribute directly to the quality of our products with your technical understanding and careful operation. Together with your team, you will ensure that production runs smoothly and that our high standards in terms of safety, quality and efficiency are met at any time. You can do this by pouring the feedthroughs as well as forming and unpacking the winding bodies operating and monitoring the casting resin system including pre- and post-processing Documenting of production and process values Repairing small disturbances as well as participation in maintenance and maintenance work Conducting quality controls on manufactured products Keeping all safety, quality and environmental regulations Active cooperation in improving processes and processes This is what you bring with your express safety and quality awareness basic technical understanding and interest in production processes Complete technical training or further training (e.g. plant guides) of advantage willingness to work in 3-shift operation Good German knowledge (at least B1) Experience in dealing with dikes, crane or lifting platform More about us Safe workplace in a future-oriented company Varied A collegial working environment with open communication Attractive social benefits and modern working conditions

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Physics of Failure & Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems.  As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione - L'opportunità Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. - In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. - Il tuo ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. - Questa è la vostra opportunità di modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi in termini di stabilità, uptime e prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprieta', prospera in un ambiente frenetico e si diverte a fare un vero impatto? Allora applica oggi! Mansioni - Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore - Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer, in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore) - Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati - Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione - La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita - Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito
• Requisiti - Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. - Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. - Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (attuazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). - Pianificazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. - Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. - Obblighi di invio nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di invio) concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung - Die Chance Fügen Sie einem hochkarätigen Photolithographie-Team bei, wo Ihr Know-how wirklich einen Einfluss hat. - Als Senior Photolithography Engineer sind Sie für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Photolithographieprozessen verantwortlich, die in der Halbleiterfertigung verwendet werden. - Ihre Rolle wird die Zusammenarbeit mit fortschrittlichen Lithographie-Ausrüstungen, die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und die Gewährleistung hochwertiger Produktionsstandards beinhalten. - Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, technische Entscheidungen zu formen, zu langfristigen Werkzeugstrategien beizutragen und sinnvolle Verbesserungen in der Stabilität, der Standzeit und der Prozessleistung zu erreichen. - Sind Sie jemand, der Eigentümer nimmt, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung lebt und genießt eine echte Wirkung? Dann bewerben Sie sich heute! Mansion - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z.B. Elektro, Mechanisch, Chemie, Materialwissenschaft oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung - Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Wafer-Photolithographie, vor allem bei der Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Produktionsumgebung (Din-Film-Kopf, Halbleiterwafer-Herstellung) - Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Waferfabrik-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Experience mit Datenextraktion, Manipulation und Analyse - Starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie - Kenntnisse in der Datenwissenschaft und -programmierung werden bevorzugt - Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse - Fähigkeit, in einer Reinraumumgebung zu arbeiten Voraussetzungen - Mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialherstellern neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um ein reibungsloses Funktionieren der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten. - Entwicklung neuer Techniken, Änderung bestehender Designs und Koordinierung von Prozessverbesserungsprojekten. - Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu identifizieren, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (implementieren und regelmäßig überprüfen SPC). - Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie. - Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzung, Diffusion, Metalle, Trockenätze und Implantat-Teams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten. - Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, um CD und Overlay zu messen. - An Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie von der Produktion verlangt) mit Teilnahme an der On-Call-Sitzung (vor dem On-Call-Demand) vereinbarte die Eigenverantwortung der anderen On-Call-Dienstleister.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione - L'opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe de photolithographie performante où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. - En tant qu'ingénieur principal de photolithographie, vous serez chargé de développer et d'optimiser les processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. - Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. - C'est l'occasion de façonner les décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'améliorer significativement la stabilité, le temps d'attente et la performance des processus. - Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Mansioni - Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou doctorat avec expérience de l'industrie - Expérience approfondie dans les opérations de photolithographie des wafers, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition dans les Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication des wafers (fabrication des wafers à feuilles minces et à semi-conducteurs) - Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données - Forte compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion - La compétence en science des données et en programmation est préférée - Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand - Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre
• Requisiti - S'engager avec les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production. - Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus. - Analyser les données du processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS). - Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'éther humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'éther sec et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente. - Supporte certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire pour mesurer CD et Overlay. - Les services de garde les week-ends et jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres prestataires de services de garde.
• Cosa offriamo - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our team as a Territory Sales Manager and support the sales of High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers for transformers produced in our Swiss and Swedish factories.  This role offers an excellent entry point into technical sales within the energy sector. As part of an experienced and supportive team, there will be the opportunity to build strong product knowledge, develop customer relationships, and gain hands-on experience in managing sales activities across defined markets.  Working closely with internal experts and customers, this position provides the chance to grow both technically and commercially while contributing to delivering reliable solutions to key industry players.  The role is based in Altstetten, Zurich, Switzerland, and involves approximately 20–30% travel.  How you'll make an impact  Support assigned markets and contributed to business development by working closely with customers to position On-Load Tap-Changers and High Voltage Bushings   Build and maintain customer relationships with transformer manufacturers and end users, including utilities and industrial customers   Track sales opportunities and contribute to accurate forecasting   Collaborate with Offer Engineering and Tendering teams when customized solutions are required   Assist in the preparation of technical and commercial offers based on customer requirements   Follow defined sales processes to ensure smooth handover to project management   Support the execution of short-term and long-term sales plans and follow up on assigned actions  Your background  Min. 2 years' experience in sales, engineering, or a similar role, ideally within energy, electrical, or industrial sectors    Technical background in electrical or mechanical engineering with an interest in commercial topics   Strong communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with customers and internal stakeholders   Structured and organized working style with attention to detail   Motivation to learn, develop and take on increasing responsibility over time   Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently when needed   Good command of English and basic to intermediate German; additional languages are a plus  More about us     Our flexible working practices help you   optimize   personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow .

jobs.title: Project Management Portfolio Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  In this role, you will take a key position at the heart of our project organization, driving excellence across a diverse project portfolio within Hitachi Energy. As Project Management Portfolio Manager, you will shape and continuously improve our project execution strategy, ensuring alignment with business goals and industry best practices.  You will lead and develop a high-performing PMO team, while partnering closely with senior stakeholders, Project Managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects successfully. By combining strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, you will strengthen our project management framework, support critical business decisions, and enable sustainable growth.  This is a unique opportunity to make a visible impact on both operational performance and organizational development, while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability.  How you'll make an impact  Contribute to implement continuous improvements for the project execution strategy for the local project operation, in alignment with BU and GPG business strategies  Develop and continuously improve processes based on industry's best practices. Ensure that findings from lessons learned from project execution are incorporated in continuous improvement actions  Participate in bid or sales phase which involves activities such as estimating and resource planning  Oversee project management activities at the portfolio level through project reviews with the management team and Project Managers  Oversee the proper application of contract and claim management methods in accordance with Hitachi Energy's policies, and contractual agreements  Lead the PMO team to establish and enforce an effective project management approach to achieve both project and organizational goals   Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders of the PMO  Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background  Master or Bachelor in the field of engineering or economics  Min. 5 years extensive Project Management experience with EPC component as well as in the electrical field  Deep knowledge about taking full ownership of the execution of complex projects and financial reporting  Proven track record of extensive leadership experience with staff responsibility  English proficiency is required, additional language skills are meritorious  Experience in transmission and distribution industry from advantage  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication
jobs.description: The opportunity The Global Manufacturing Process Lead - GPG DT - Transformer Cores Fabrication is responsible for defining, leading, and continuously improving the end-to-end engineering and manufacturing-related processes for transformers magnetic cores within the Global Product Group (GPG), covering distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, and traction transformers. This role has a strong focus on core manufacturing processes, including lamination handling, cutting, stacking, core assembly, clamping, insulation interfaces, losses control, dimensional accuracy, and industrialization readiness, ensuring alignment between design, manufacturing, suppliers, and digital platforms. The position supports the “Design Anywhere, Manufacture Anywhere” strategy by standardizing processes, enabling digital tools, and ensuring that best practices in core manufacturing engineering are consistently deployed across factories worldwide. The role drives Lean, Digital Transformation, and Value Stream improvements, ensuring speed, quality, and robustness of magnetic core processes while reducing manual activities and variability. Close collaboration with Factory Engineering Process Managers, Digital Transformation Leads, Platform\/Tool teams, and Supply Chain is essential. How you'll make an impact You own global engineering and manufacturing processes for magnetic cores. You set clear standards that ensure quality, consistency, and efficiency. You standardize how cores are designed, built, and assembled worldwide. You ensure processes scale across factories and production volumes. You review processes regularly and drive continuous improvement. You improve efficiency, quality, and lead times through structured improvements. You identify where automation and digital tools add real value. You define requirements for tools that support design and manufacturing. You connect engineering with operations, supply chain, and suppliers. You lead a global network that applies standards safely and consistently. Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.

jobs.title: Scientist in Generative AI and Large Language Models (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist with expertise in Large Language Models and Generative AI to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic, motivated, and creative team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all.   How you'll make an impact   You are creative : Conduct high-quality industrial research in the areas of Generative AI and Large Language Models for sustainable power grids, green energy and related fields You are impactful: Develop innovative software solutions, turn them into prototypes and increase their technology readiness towards productization You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Business Units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in technical reports, patent applications, and scientific publications   Your background   PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field Proven expertise in GenAI technologies spanning Large Language Models, reasoning methods, and agentic systems, with strong knowledge of relevant algorithms, frameworks, and tools Expertise in scalable and high-performance computing Good knowledge of the NVIDIA AI\/ML SW technology stack Strong ability and keen interest in applying AI to real-world industrial applications and business cases related to the energy sector and driving the emerging research in this field toward productization Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, both written and spoken

jobs.title: Junior Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. How you'll make an impact Improve the process capability of module assembly processes, by applying statistical tools, designed experiments and gemba principles Analyse production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial or mechanical Good understanding of automation, experience in robot handling is advantageous Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in English, German highly beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Come leader globale nella tecnologia dei semiconduttori di potenza, offriamo uno dei portafogli di prodotti più diversi nel settore. I nostri prodotti includono tiristori, diodi, tiristori a cancello, tiristori integrati a cancello, transistor bipolari a porte isolate e transistor a effetto campo a semiconduttore metallico. Questi componenti sono affidabili in settori quali la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia, la mobilità e l'energia rinnovabile per la loro eccezionale qualità e affidabilità. Nel ruolo di Process Engineer per BiMOS Backend, contribuirai all'avanzamento della nostra produzione di moduli di potenza automatizzata. Avrete l'opportunità di migliorare i processi di produzione esistenti e di condurre progetti di sviluppo innovativi, con particolare attenzione ai processi di assemblaggio dei moduli automatizzati. Migliorare la capacità di processo dei processi di assemblaggio dei moduli, applicando strumenti statistici, esperimenti progettati e principi di gemba Analizzare i dati di produzione per ottimizzare le prestazioni, identificare le tendenze a lungo termine e prevenire potenziali guasti Supportare la risoluzione dei problemi e l'analisi delle cause radice per mantenere e migliorare la produttività Grazie al nuovo sviluppo del prodotto, modellando il paesaggio del processo di produzione e consentendo la produzione del volume.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Power-Halbleiter-Technologie bieten wir eines der unterschiedlichsten Produktportfolios der Branche. Unsere Produkte umfassen Thyristoren, Dioden, Abschaltthyristoren, integrierte Gate-kommutierte Thyristoren, isoliert-Gate-Bipolartransistoren und Metall-Oxid-Halbleiter-Feldeffekttransistoren. Diese Komponenten vertrauen auf Branchen wie Stromübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbare Energien für ihre außergewöhnliche Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit. In der Rolle von Process Engineer für BiMOS Backend tragen Sie zur Weiterentwicklung unserer automatisierten Leistungsmodulproduktion bei. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, bestehende Fertigungsprozesse zu verbessern und innovative Entwicklungsprojekte zu führen, mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf automatisierten Modulbauprozessen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Verbessern Sie die Prozessfähigkeit der Modulmontageprozesse, indem Sie statistische Werkzeuge, konstruierte Experimente und gemba Prinzipien anwenden Analyse der Produktionsdaten zur Optimierung der Leistung, zur Identifizierung langfristiger Trends und zur Vermeidung potenzieller Ausfälle Unterstützung der Fehlersuche und der Wurzel verursachen Analyse zur Aufrechterhaltung und Verbesserung des Produktionsdurchsatzes Zusammenarbeit bei der Entwicklung neuer Produkte durch die Gestaltung der Produktionsprozesse Landschaft und die Bereitstellung von Volumenproduktion Ihr Hintergrund Ein Master-Abschluss in der industriellen oder mechanischen Gutes Verständnis der Automatisierung, Erfahrung im Roboterhandling ist von Vorteil Starke analytische und Problemlösungsstatistiken, eine qualitätsorientierte Denkweise.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que leader mondial de la technologie des semi-conducteurs électriques, nous offrons l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés de l'industrie. Nos produits comprennent des thyristors, des diodes, des thyristors à interrupteur de porte, des thyristors intégrés à interrupteur de porte, des transistors bipolaires isolés et des transistors métal-oxyde-semiconducteurs à effet de champ. Ces composants sont fiables dans des secteurs tels que le transport et la distribution d'électricité, la mobilité et les énergies renouvelables pour leur qualité et leur fiabilité exceptionnelles. Dans le rôle de Process Engineer pour BiMOS Backend, vous contribuerez à l'avancement de notre production de module d'alimentation automatisée. Vous aurez l'occasion d'améliorer les procédés de fabrication existants et de diriger des projets de développement innovants, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les processus d'assemblage de modules automatisés. Comment faire un impact Améliorer la capacité de traitement des processus de montage de modules, en appliquant des outils statistiques, des expériences conçues et des principes gemba Analyser les données de production pour optimiser les performances, identifier les tendances à long terme et prévenir les défaillances potentielles Soutenir le dépannage et l'analyse des causes profondes pour maintenir et améliorer le débit de production Collaborer au développement d'un nouveau produit en façonnant le paysage des processus de production et en permettant la fabrication de volumes Vos antécédents Maîtrise en automatisation industrielle ou mécanique Une bonne compréhension de l'automatisation, l'expérience dans la manipulation de robots est avantageuse Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, un état d'esprit axé sur la qualité et une approche proactive et pratique Familialité avec le DoE, l'analyse de données et les statistiques de production est un plus Compétence en anglais, allemand hautement bénéfique Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et commerciales tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Internship on Power Systems of the Future 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join a dynamic research team shaping the future of energy systems. You will explore how renewable energy, smart grids, and sector coupling are transforming power systems worldwide. This 6 months internship offers a unique chance to contribute to next-generation solutions while developing your skills in a supportive and flexible environment. You'll work closely with experts across business units and gain valuable insights into innovation and sustainability. How you'll make an impact Perform market analysis on renewables and smart grid topics Derive system and product requirements based on the market analysis Define high-level functional architectures for future solutions Simulate future energy scenarios and technologies Model emerging technologies across power system levels (e.g. DC grids, electro-mobility, energy storage, electrolyzes and fuel cells, demand response, etc.) Develop, maintain and document new techno-economic assessment tools for simulating behavior of energy systems on different time scale Build future energy scenarios on regional and global scales Your background Currently pursuing a M.S. degree in electrical engineering or completed a similar M.S. degree less than 12 months ago Familiar with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi) integrated into simulation workflows developed in MATLAB and Python Experience with renewable energy and smart grid technologies, solutions, and concepts, combined with proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar Excellent communicator in English, both in writing and speaking Background in the following power system topics: steady-state and dynamic stability analysis and modeling, fault analysis and power system protection, energy and ancillary service markets Self-starter with a strong willingness to learn, capable of working independently while also being a reliable and collaborative team player More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a un team di ricerca dinamico che modella il futuro dei sistemi energetici. Scoprirete come le energie rinnovabili, le reti intelligenti e l'accoppiamento del settore stanno trasformando i sistemi di energia in tutto il mondo. Questo tirocinio di 6 mesi offre la possibilità unica di contribuire a soluzioni di nuova generazione, sviluppando le vostre competenze in un ambiente flessibile e di supporto. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con esperti di business unit e ottenere preziose informazioni sull'innovazione e la sostenibilità. Eseguire l'analisi del mercato sulle energie rinnovabili e sugli argomenti della rete intelligente Requisiti del sistema e del prodotto basati sull'analisi di mercato Definire architetture funzionali di alto livello per le soluzioni future Simulano scenari energetici futuri e tecnologie Modello tecnologie emergenti attraverso i livelli del sistema di potenza (ad esempio griglie DC, elettro-mobilità, stoccaggio di energia, elettrolizza e celle a combustibile, risposta della domanda, ecc.) Sviluppare, mantenere e documentare nuovi strumenti di valutazione tecno-economica per simulare il comportamento dei sistemi energetici su scala temporale diversa Il tuo background Attualmente persegue un M.S. in ingegneria elettrica o ha completato un simile grado di M.S. inferiore a 12 mesi fa Familiare con i risolutori di ottimizzazione (ad esempio, Gurobi) integrato in flussi di lavoro di simulazione sviluppati in MATLAB e Python Experience con le tecnologie, le soluzioni, i concetti, insieme con la competenza in strumenti di analisi del sistema di potenza come PowerFactory, PSCAD, o simile comunicatore stabile in inglese,
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine dynamische und erfahrene Führungskraft für den Einkauf, die unser engagiertes Service-Team bei Hitachi, Ltd. verstärkt, wo Geschwindigkeit und Qualität von größter Bedeutung sind. In dieser Schlüsselposition führen Sie strategische Einkaufsinitiativen, optimieren die Beschaffungsprozesse und leiten ein talentiertes Team von etwa 12 Einkaufsexperten. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. Die Anwendung der Critical-Path-Methode zur Sicherstellung pünktlicher Beschaffungsprozesse und zur Minimierung von Lieferverzögerungen gehört zu Ihren Kernaufgaben. Sie gewährleisten durchgängige Exzellenz im gesamten Einkaufsprozess – von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zur Zahlung – und sorgen für klare Abläufe sowie maximale Transparenz. Sie definieren und steuern die Lieferanten-Segmentierung und entwickeln zielgerichtete Beschaffungsstrategien. Zudem verantworten Sie die Auswahl, Qualifizierung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Durch den Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften auf Führungsebene und die Etablierung robuster Lieferantenmanagement-Systeme mit KPIs, Scorecards, regelmässigen Reviews und Eskalationsprozessen sichern Sie die nachhaltige Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Lieferantennetzwerks. Sie arbeiten eng mit abteilungsübergreifenden Teams wie Materialplanung, Engineering, Qualität und Controlling zusammen, um den Einkauf optimal auf die Unternehmensanforderungen abzustimmen. Sie steuern einkaufsbezogene Risiken, einschließlich Lieferkettenstörungen, Preisschwankungen und Compliance-Themen. Das bringen Sie mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Einkauf oder Supply Chain Management oder mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich. Nachweisbare Erfolge im strategischen Einkauf, in Verhandlungen und im Lieferanten- oder Kundenmanagement sind von Vorteil. Sehr gutes Verständnis von Einkaufsprozessen, Vertragsrecht und Prinzipien der Lieferkette. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsvermögen. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Einkauf-Software (z.B. SAP Ariba) und Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem schnelllebigen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu managen. Ihre Expertise sorgt für eine schnelle und kosteneffiziente Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen, während Sie höchste Qualitätsstandards wahren und langfristige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu Lieferanten fördern. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. Die Anwendung der Critical-Path-Methode zur Sicherstellung pünktlicher Beschaffungsprozesse und zur Minimierung von Lieferverzögerungen gehört zu Ihren Kernaufgaben. Sie gewährleisten durchgängige Exzellenz im gesamten Einkaufsprozess – von der Bedarfsermittlung bis zur Zahlung – und sorgen für klare Abläufe sowie maximale Transparenz. Sie definieren und steuern die Lieferanten-Segmentierung und entwickeln zielgerichtete Beschaffungsstrategien. Zudem verantworten Sie die Auswahl, Qualifizierung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit Lieferanten. Durch den Aufbau strategischer Partnerschaften auf Führungsebene und die Etablierung robuster Lieferantenmanagement-Systeme mit KPIs, Scorecards, regelmässigen Reviews und Eskalationsprozessen sichern Sie die nachhaltige Leistungsfähigkeit unseres Lieferantennetzwerks. Sie arbeiten eng mit abteilungsübergreifenden Teams wie Materialplanung, Engineering, Qualität und Controlling zusammen, um den Einkauf optimal auf die Unternehmensanforderungen abzustimmen. Sie steuern einkaufsbezogene Risiken, einschließlich Lieferkettenstörungen, Preisschwankungen und Compliance-Themen. Das bringen Sie mit Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Supply Chain Management, Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Einkauf oder Supply Chain Management oder mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung in einem verwandten Bereich. Nachweisbare Erfolge im strategischen Einkauf, in Verhandlungen und im Lieferanten- oder Kundenmanagement sind von Vorteil. Sehr gutes Verständnis von Einkaufsprozessen, Vertragsrecht und Prinzipien der Lieferkette. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsvermögen. Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Einkauf-Software (z.B. SAP Ariba) und Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel. Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem schnelllebigen, internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten zu managen. Erfahrung in den Bereichen Fertigung, Technologie oder Industrie ist sehr wünschenswert. descriptionByLocale.fr: La possibilité Nous recherchons un cadre dynamique et expérimenté pour l'achat qui renforce notre équipe de service dédiée à Hitachi, Ltd., où la vitesse et la qualité sont de la plus haute importance. Dans cette position clé, vous réalisez des initiatives d'achat stratégiques, optimisez les processus d'approvisionnement et dirigez une équipe talentueuse d'environ 12 experts en achats. Votre expertise assure un achat rapide et rentable de biens et de services tout en maintenant les normes de qualité les plus élevées et en favorisant des relations de partenariat à long terme avec les fournisseurs. Cela vous permet de prendre en charge le leadership, la promotion et le développement de notre équipe d'achat et de créer une culture d'entreprise axée sur le rendement et responsable. Ils élaborent et mettent en oeuvre des concepts d'approvisionnement novateurs conformément à notre stratégie de service. Ce faisant, vous insistez particulièrement sur la livraison en temps opportun, l'amélioration continue de la qualité, l'amélioration de l'efficacité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la réduction durable des coûts. L'application de la méthode Critical-Path pour assurer des processus d'approvisionnement en temps opportun et pour minimiser les retards de livraison est l'une de vos tâches principales. Ils assurent une excellence constante tout au long du processus d'achat – de la détermination de la demande au paiement – et garantissent des processus clairs et une transparence maximale. Ils définissent et contrôlent la segmentation des fournisseurs et élaborent des stratégies d'approvisionnement ciblées. De plus, vous êtes responsable de la sélection, de la qualification et des négociations contractuelles avec les fournisseurs. En établissant des partenariats stratégiques au niveau du leadership et en mettant en place des systèmes robustes de gestion des fournisseurs avec des ICR, des cartes de pointage, des examens réguliers et des processus d'escalade, vous pouvez assurer la performance durable de notre réseau de fournisseurs. Ils travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interministérielles telles que la planification des matériaux, l'ingénierie, la qualité et le contrôle, afin d'adapter au mieux l'achat aux exigences de l'entreprise. Ils contrôlent les risques liés aux achats, y compris les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les fluctuations des prix et les problèmes de conformité. Cela vous amène avec des études terminées dans le domaine de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la gestion d'entreprise, de l'ingénierie ou une formation comparable avec une expérience professionnelle pertinente. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en gestion des achats ou de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou au moins 3 ans d'expérience en leadership dans un domaine connexe. Les succès détectés dans les achats stratégiques, les négociations et la gestion des fournisseurs ou des clients sont avantageux. Très bonne compréhension des processus d'achat, du droit des contrats et des principes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Des compétences analytiques réduites ainsi que la résolution de problèmes et la prise de décisions. Excellente communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles. Très bonne connaissance des logiciels d'achat (par exemple SAP Ariba) et Microsoft Office, en particulier Excel. Capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international accéléré et de gérer de multiples priorités. L'expérience dans la fabrication, la technologie ou l'industrie est très souhaitable. Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent se développer et croître. jobs.title: Service Project & Tender Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
