jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Contribute to the development of the business unit's supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and alignment with business objectives. Monitor emerging material sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and customer requirements, integrating them into strategic and operational plans. Develop standardized process flows for material sustainability requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and effective implementation. Identify opportunities to enhance material sustainability, driving projects such as decarbonization efforts and improving practices with key global suppliers. Implement performance monitoring systems to track progress against material sustainability goals, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement. Develop and maintain a comprehensive database of primary sustainability data for materials, ensuring accurate information and promoting adoption across the supply chain. This includes defining the data needed to enable consistent LCA\/EPD\/PCF assessments and comparable material-level impact evaluations. Engage with suppliers and cross-functional teams to guide strategic suppliers toward emission-zero goals and sustainable practices. Develop and deliver training on material sustainability topics, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and best practices across the SCM community. jobs.title: Internship in Low-Code Development 80 - 100% (f/m(d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. If you are passionate about technology, enjoy hands-on work and want to see how your ideas create real added value, we look forward to hearing from you. How you'll make an impact Familiarization with existing applications based on the Microsoft Power Platform Supporting the further expansion and development of the application landscape in the service sector Analysing business processes and identifying opportunities for automation Developing low-code applications based on business requirements Collaborating with developers and service departments Supporting the documentation of applications and processes Your background Currently studying Computer Science, Business Informatics or a similar subject Initial experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, etc.) or comparable low-code technologies Basic understanding of programming and digital applications and a structured way of working  Interest in operational business processes, ideally in the service or industrial sector Independent as well as team player with a willingness to learn and a strong motivation to develop further Good command of German and English More about us We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team.   Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation isothermes. Nous assurons la haute fiabilité de nos systèmes en utilisant des outils et des méthodes de développement de pointe. Pour notre unité d'affaires Produits haute tension, nous recherchons un responsable fonctionnel de l'équipe de normalisation en génie secondaire. Dans cette position difficile, vous prendrez la direction fonctionnelle de l'équipe de normalisation pour faire avancer la normalisation et les améliorations des produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie secondaire en Suisse, en Allemagne et en Inde et développerez une feuille de route de normalisation qui guidera le développement de notre produit pour l'avenir. En collaboration avec l'équipe de normalisation, vous assurerez la mise en œuvre réussie des améliorations, telles que la publication de nouveaux modèles et de lignes directrices d'ingénierie qui permettent à l'ingénierie de réaliser ses projets de manière efficace et de haute qualité. Comment vous ferez un impact Diriger fonctionnellement l'équipe de normalisation du génie secondaire, y compris la gestion quotidienne des tâches, la planification et l'équilibre de la charge de travail de l'équipe, assurer le progrès, la transparence et l'utilisation efficace de la capacité de l'équipe et le développement des compétences requises l'équipe Définir les normes de conception du génie secondaire du SIG par l'élaboration de modèles et de lignes directrices de conception avec l'appui de l'équipe de normalisation et des experts Élaborer, maintenir et mettre à jour régulièrement la feuille de route pour la normalisation du génie secondaire, en collaboration avec les membres de l'équipe de normalisation, les principaux intervenants du génie secondaire et d'autres départements S'engager dans le processus de qualité et les cycles d'amélioration continue de l'organisation du SIG et collaborer activement avec d'autres équipes d'ingénieurs et intervenants pour discuter, évaluer et harmoniser les améliorations, et les hiérarchiser pour la mise en oeuvre. Vos antécédents Expérience en génie électrique Capacité démontrée de diriger avec succès, soit en poste de direction, soit dans des projets complexes et exigeants Expérience solide en génie des équipements secondaires (LCC) comme génie secondaire PM Expérience des outils correspondants utilisés pour la préparation en génie secondaire pour assumer le rôle de leadership fonctionnel au sein d'une équipe. Expérience éprouvée en gestion de projet, certification p. ex. comme PMP est une fluence plus en anglais. L'allemand ou toute autre langue est un plus Le propriétaire d'emploi vit une pensée innovante et axée sur la performance ainsi que de suivre les valeurs de Hitachi Energy et apporte une contribution personnelle à une bonne ambiance de travail Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Team Manager – Next Generation Grids Transformers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Hitachi Energy is seeking an experienced and motivated R&D Team Manager to lead our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva, Switzerland.   In this role, you will manage a team of 5+ engineers and drive the development of advanced and innovative technologies, including medium frequency transformers and power electronics enhanced transformers. You will combine people leadership with strong technical guidance and project ownership, contributing to the execution of R&D strategy in a global environment.  How you'll make an impact     Lead, develop, and motivate an international R&D team of 5+ engineers with know-how in medium frequency transformers, power converters and lab testing Provide technical leadership and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges  Contribute to R&D strategy and technology direction, including development of roadmaps for the New Generation Grids Transformers product line  Plan, drive, and deliver R&D projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and quality targets  Collaborate closely with global R&D teams, engineering functions, and external partners  Manage project resources and budgets to maximize impact and operational efficiency Site R&D laboratory and infrastructure responsibility, including driving expansion plans  Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to improve performance  Your background    Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field  Several years of industrial experience in product development, or technology management  Strong technical background in transformers and power converters  Proven experience in project management within R&D or product development  Experience in leading technical teams (line or project leadership) and working in international and cross-functional environments  Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) as well as stakeholder engagement capabilities  More about us You will join a collaborative and international R&D environment at the forefront of next-generation grid technologies. Working in Geneva, you will contribute to innovative transformer solutions that support the energy transition and the development of more flexible and sustainable power systems. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

jobs.title: Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  As a Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist part of the local HSE team, you will play a key role in participating to HSE development, with main focus on Environmental topic, but granting a good support on Health & Safety activities.  Key tasks on the Environmental side will be related to safeguarding our site's environmental integrity and driving our sustainability ambitions forward. In this role, you will ensure full compliance with all relevant environmental laws, regulations, and permits, while fostering strong relationships with community stakeholders and environmental authorities. You will develop, implement, and maintain robust environmental policies and procedures that promote accountability across the organization. By conducting environmental risk assessments, delivering training on sustainability practices, and leading initiatives that improve resource efficiency, you will directly contribute to reducing the factory's environmental footprint and supporting long-term operational excellence.  On the H&S part, you'll be required to support main Health and Safety development activities organized by the HSE Manager, delivering results according to Management expectations.  Please submit your application in English.   How you'll make an impact  Ensure regulatory compliance with Swiss environmental law and related frameworks (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), including permit management and coordination with cantonal authorities (BAFU)  Lead environmental impact assessments for new production lines, plant changes, and modifications, ensuring alignment with internal environmental policies  Manage waste and disposals, including segregation, traceability, registers, supplier audits, and all special waste streams, while supporting wastereduction and VVEA improvement initiatives  Oversee chemical compliance, including ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, Manage and maintain Safety SDS requirements, and notifications of new substances  Support safe handling and storage of dangerous goods (DG) by coordinating with relevant departments and ensuring ongoing compliance  Plan and conduct environmental audits and inspections, identifying improvement areas and ensuring timely corrective actions, also providing environmental compliance support and training to Engineering, Maintenance, and overall Business Unit, including REACH\/RoHS documentation and sustainability-related data needs  On the Health and Safety part, you're required to support HSE manager in H&S-related topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation.  Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders.  Your background  Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental regulations and compliance obligations   Solid understanding of best practices in emissions, waste, water, chemicals, and sustainability   Strong analytical skills, including environmental data processing and use of relevant software tools   Basic knowledge of H&S principles and concepts   Excellent command of Office 365 applications   Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess environmental risks and develop effective mitigation strategies   Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with diverse internal and external stakeholders   Fluent in Italian and English  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Come Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist parte del team HSE locale, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella partecipazione allo sviluppo HSE, con l'obiettivo principale sul tema ambientale, ma garantendo un buon supporto alle attività di salute e sicurezza. I compiti chiave sul lato ambientale saranno legati alla salvaguardia dell'integrità ambientale del nostro sito e alla promozione delle nostre ambizioni di sostenibilità. In questo ruolo, si assicurerà il pieno rispetto di tutte le pertinenti leggi ambientali, regolamenti e permessi, mentre promuovendo forti relazioni con le parti interessate della comunità e le autorità ambientali. Si svilupperà, implementerà e manterrà robuste politiche e procedure ambientali che promuovono la responsabilità in tutta l'organizzazione. Condurre valutazioni dei rischi ambientali, fornire formazione sulle pratiche di sostenibilità e le principali iniziative che migliorano l'efficienza delle risorse, contribuirà direttamente a ridurre l'impronta ambientale della fabbrica e sostenere l'eccellenza operativa a lungo termine. Nella parte H&S, sarai tenuto a sostenere le principali attività di sviluppo della salute e della sicurezza organizzate dal HSE Manager, offrendo risultati secondo le aspettative della Direzione. Invia la tua richiesta in inglese. Assicurare il rispetto delle normative in materia ambientale e dei relativi quadri (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), comprese le norme relative alla gestione dei permessi e al coordinamento con le autorità cantonali (BAFU) Nella parte Salute e Sicurezza, sei tenuto a sostenere HSE manager in temi legati alla H&S che gestiscono attività di produzione e attrezzature con i più elevati standard di sicurezza, sia sul piano pratico che sulla preparazione della documentazione. Sostenere le attività di reportistica HSE richieste dagli stakeholder interni governativi o Hitachi Energy. Il vostro background Min. 3 anni di esperienza in ruoli ambientali all'interno del settore industriale e una forte conoscenza delle normative ambientali e degli obblighi di conformità Solida comprensione delle migliori pratiche in termini di emissioni, rifiuti, acqua, prodotti chimici e sostenibilità Forte competenze analitiche, tra cui il trattamento dei dati ambientali e l'utilizzo di strumenti software rilevanti Conoscenza di base dei principi e concetti H&S Ottimo comando di Office 365 applicazioni Forte capacità di problem solving con la capacità di valutare i rischi ambientali e sviluppare strategie di mitigazione efficaci.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit Als spezialisierter Teil des lokalen HSE-Teams von Factory Environmental and Employe Health & Safety werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Teilnahme an der HSE-Entwicklung spielen, mit Schwerpunkt auf Umweltthemen, aber eine gute Unterstützung für Gesundheit und Sicherheit. Die wichtigsten
• Aufgaben auf der Umweltseite werden sich auf die Sicherung der Umweltintegrität unserer Website und die Durchsetzung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsziele beziehen. In dieser Rolle sorgen Sie für die volle Einhaltung aller einschlägigen Umweltgesetze, -vorschriften und -genehmigungen und fördern gleichzeitig starke Beziehungen zu Interessenvertretern und Umweltbehörden der Gemeinschaft. Sie entwickeln, implementieren und pflegen robuste Umweltpolitiken und -verfahren, die die Rechenschaftspflicht im gesamten Unternehmen fördern. Durch Umweltrisikobewertungen, Schulungen zu Nachhaltigkeitspraktiken und führende Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Ressourceneffizienz werden Sie direkt dazu beitragen, den ökologischen Fußabdruck der Fabrik zu reduzieren und langfristige betriebliche Exzellenz zu unterstützen. Zum H&S-Teil werden Sie verpflichtet, die wichtigsten Aktivitäten der Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsentwicklung, die vom HSE-Manager organisiert werden, zu unterstützen und die Ergebnisse nach den Erwartungen der Managements zu liefern. Bitte geben Sie Ihre Bewerbung in Englisch ein. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Einhaltung des schweizerischen Umweltrechts und der damit verbundenen Rahmenbedingungen (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO) gewährleisten, einschließlich Genehmigungsmanagement und Koordinierung mit Kantonalbehörden (RoFU) Führen Sie Umweltverträglichkeitsprüfungen für neue Produktionslinien, Anlagenänderungen und Änderungen, Im Bereich Gesundheit und Sicherheit sind Sie verpflichtet, HSE-Manager in H&S-bezogenen Themen zu unterstützen, die Produktionsaktivitäten und Ausrüstungen mit den höchsten Sicherheitsstandards verwalten, sowohl im praktischen als auch in der Dokumentationsvorbereitung. Unterstützung von HSE-Reporting-Aktivitäten, die von staatlichen oder Hitachi Energy internen Akteuren benötigt werden. Ihr Hintergrund Min. 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Umweltrollen im Industriebereich und starkes Wissen über die schweizerischen Umweltvorschriften und Compliance-Verpflichtungen Solides Verständnis der besten Praktiken in Emissionen, Abfall, Wasser, Chemikalien und Nachhaltigkeit Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, einschließlich Umweltdatenverarbeitung und Nutzung relevanter Software-Tools Grundkenntnisse von H&S-Grundsätzen und Konzepten Hervorragender Befehl von Office 365-Anwendungen Starke Problemlösungen mit der Fähigkeit, Umweltrisiken zu bewerten und effektive Klimaschutzstrategien zu entwickeln.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de l'environnement et de la sécurité des employés faisant partie de l'équipe locale de SSE, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la participation au développement de SSE, en mettant l'accent sur le thème environnemental, mais en accordant un bon soutien aux activités de SSE. Les principales tâches du côté environnemental seront liées à la protection de l'intégrité environnementale de notre site et à la promotion de nos ambitions en matière de durabilité. Dans ce rôle, vous assurerez le plein respect de toutes les lois, règlements et permis environnementaux pertinents, tout en favorisant des relations solides avec les intervenants communautaires et les autorités environnementales. Vous allez élaborer, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des politiques et des procédures environnementales solides qui favorisent la reddition de comptes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. En procédant à des évaluations des risques environnementaux, en offrant une formation sur les pratiques de durabilité et en dirigeant des initiatives qui améliorent l'efficacité des ressources, vous contribuerez directement à réduire l'empreinte environnementale de l'usine et à soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle à long terme. En ce qui a trait à la santé et à la sécurité, vous devrez appuyer les principales activités de développement de la santé et de la sécurité organisées par le gestionnaire de l'ESH, en donnant des résultats en fonction des attentes de la direction. Veuillez soumettre votre candidature en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Assurer la conformité réglementaire avec le droit suisse de l'environnement et les cadres connexes (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), y compris la gestion des permis et la coordination avec les autorités cantonales (BAFU) Diriger les évaluations de l'impact environnemental pour les nouvelles lignes de production, les changements d'usine et les modifications, assurer l'alignement sur les politiques environnementales internes Gérer les déchets et les éliminations, y compris la ségrégation, la traçabilité, les registres, les audits des fournisseurs et tous les flux spéciaux de déchets, tout en appuyant les initiatives de réduction des déchets et d'amélioration de la VVEA Surveiller la conformité chimique, y compris ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, gérer et maintenir les exigences de la SDD en matière de sécurité, et les notifications de nouvelles substances Soutenir la manutention et l'entreposage sécuritaires des marchandises dangereuses (DG) en coordonnant avec les ministères concernés et en assurant la conformité continue Plan et des vérifications et inspections environnementales, en déterminant les domaines d'amélioration et en veillant à des mesures Pour ce qui est de la santé et de la sécurité, vous êtes tenu d'appuyer le gestionnaire de l'ESH dans la gestion des activités de production et de l'équipement ayant les normes de sécurité les plus élevées, tant sur le plan pratique que sur la préparation de la documentation. Appuyer les activités de rapport sur les ESE requises par les intervenants internes du gouvernement ou de Hitachi Energy. Vos antécédents 3 ans d'expérience dans les rôles environnementaux dans le secteur industriel et une solide connaissance de la réglementation et des obligations suisses en matière d'environnement Compréhension solide des meilleures pratiques en matière d'émissions, de déchets, d'eau, de produits chimiques et de durabilité Fortes compétences analytiques, y compris le traitement des données environnementales et l'utilisation d'outils logiciels pertinents Connaissance de base des principes et concepts de H & S Excellente maîtrise des applications Office 365 Fortes compétences en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'évaluer les risques environnementaux et d'élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation efficaces Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite pour s'engager auprès de divers intervenants internes et externes Fluent en italien et en anglais Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

jobs.title: Internship in Computational Chemistry 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months.    How you'll make an impact  Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization  Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages  Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team    Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods  Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage  Fluency in written and spoken English  Team player and well organized  Creative and able to work autonomously  Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus  More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità In questo ruolo, sarai un esperto di materia riconosciuta nella sicurezza, fornendo un supporto funzionale competente in un paese o in un cluster di paesi. Sarete responsabili per la ricerca, l'analisi e l'interpretazione di minacce di sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero influenzare dipendenti, beni o operazioni. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'attuazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Segnalando al Capo della Sicurezza Regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, professionisti di livello inferiore, e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di sicurezza esperti. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Analizzare le minacce di sicurezza nazionali e internazionali emergenti e fornire valutazioni tempestive e consiglieri. - Fornire un supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza regionali e i KPI. - Assicurare la conformità attraverso audit, controlli e monitoraggio della legislazione in evoluzione della sicurezza. - Fornire consigli di gestione dei rischi di sicurezza esperti per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave. - Miglioramento continuo e cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali. - Coinvolgere gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni della sicurezza. - Guidare o sostenere progetti legati alla sicurezza, gestire obiettivi, risorse e reporting. - Coordinare la resilienza organizzativa, la risposta di emergenza e la gestione delle crisi a livello nazionale. Il tuo sfondo - Min. 5 anni Istruzione avanzata e esperienza significativa come specialista di sicurezza. - Competenza comprovata nell'intelligenza delle minacce, nell'analisi dei rischi e nella gestione delle crisi. - Forte comprensione degli standard di sicurezza, della legislazione, dei requisiti di conformità e dei processi di audit. - Esperienza di coaching e consulenza leader su questioni di sicurezza all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa. - Affari fluenti in tedesco e inglese. - Capacità dimostrata di gestire i programmi di sicurezza, progetti e budget in modo efficace. - Abilitato nel coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione interfunzionale. - Esperienza nella resilienza organizzativa, risposta di emergenza e coordinamento della continuità aziendale. - Capacità di operare in un ambiente di matrice globale e gestire le responsabilità in più paesi. - Approsso. 30% Viaggi richiesto Maggiori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous serez un expert reconnu en matière de sécurité, fournissant un soutien fonctionnel compétent dans un pays ou un groupe de pays. Vous serez responsable de la recherche, de l'analyse et de l'interprétation des nouvelles menaces à la sécurité qui pourraient avoir des répercussions sur les employés, les biens ou les opérations. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résilience organisationnelle, la gestion des crises et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de sécurité mondiales et régionales d'Hitachi Energy. Sous l'autorité du chef de la Sécurité régionale, vous gérerez des projets complexes avec une supervision limitée, coacherez des professionnels de niveau inférieur et contribuerez aux décisions d'affaires critiques grâce à des connaissances spécialisées en matière de sécurité. Comment vous ferez un impact - Analyser les nouvelles menaces à la sécurité nationale et internationale et fournir des évaluations et des avis en temps opportun. - Fournir un soutien de sécurité compétent dans tout le pays/groupe, en assurant l'alignement sur les normes de sécurité régionales et les ICR. - Assurer la conformité par des vérifications, des inspections et la surveillance de l'évolution de la législation en matière de sécurité. - Fournir des conseils spécialisés en gestion des risques de sécurité pour appuyer les décisions clés des entreprises. - Favoriser l'amélioration continue et le changement de comportement grâce à des initiatives de sécurité mondiales et régionales. - Mobiliser les acteurs internes et externes pour renforcer la sensibilisation à la sécurité et les performances. - Diriger ou appuyer des projets liés à la sécurité, gérer les objectifs, les ressources et les rapports. - Coordonner la résilience organisationnelle, les interventions d'urgence et la gestion des crises au niveau des pays. Vos antécédents - Moins de 5 ans Études supérieures et expérience importante en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité. - Expertise éprouvée en renseignement, analyse des risques et gestion des crises. - Une bonne compréhension des normes de sécurité, de la législation, des exigences de conformité et des processus de vérification. - Expérience de l'encadrement et des conseils aux dirigeants sur les questions de sécurité au sein d'une organisation complexe. - Les affaires parlent couramment allemand et anglais. - Capacité démontrée de gérer efficacement les programmes, les projets et les budgets de sécurité. - Compétence en engagement des intervenants, communication et collaboration interfonctionnelle. - Expérience en matière de résilience organisationnelle, d'intervention d'urgence et de coordination de la continuité des opérations. - Capacité de fonctionner dans un environnement matriciel mondial et de gérer les responsabilités dans plusieurs pays. - Env. 30% Voyage requis Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Umweltspezialist 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte aktiv die Zukunft mit – dort, wo Sicherheit und Innovation aufeinandertreffen. Wir suchen eine engagierte und fachkompetente Umweltspezialistin bzw. einen engagierten und fachkompetenten Umweltspezialisten, die\/der unser Bestreben nach einem sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsumfeld weiter stärkt. In dieser zentralen Funktion verantwortest du Initiativen zum Schutz unserer Mitarbeitenden, stellst die Einhaltung relevanter Vorschriften sicher und förderst eine proaktive Sicherheits- und Umweltkultur im gesamten Unternehmen. Das kannst du bewirken Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie interner Richtlinien Durchführen von Risiko‑, Gefahren‑ und Umweltanalysen inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Planen und Durchführen von internen Audits, Begehungen und Umweltkontrollen Untersuchen von Unfällen und Ereignissen sowie Erarbeitung von Präventionsmassnahmen Mitarbeit an Nachhaltigkeit‑ und Umweltprojekten sowie Förderung der Umweltkultur Erstellen und Durchführen von Schulungen zu Umwelt‑ und Sicherheitsrelevanten Themen Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Projektteams bei HSE‑Fragestellungen Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Auditoren und externen Partnern Das bringst du mit Abschluss in Umweltwissenschaften, Umwelttechnik, Arbeitssicherheit oder einem vergleichbaren technischen\/naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (FH\/Universität) Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im HSE oder Umweltbereich, idealerweise in Industrie, Produktion oder technischen Organisationen Fundierte Kenntnisse der Schweizer Arbeitssicherheits- und Umweltgesetzgebung, inklusive relevanter Verordnungen (z. B. Störfallverordnung, Chemikalienrecht, Umweltschutzrecht) Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen, Gefahrenermittlungen sowie Unfall und Ereignisabklärungen, inklusive Ableitung von Massnahmen Praxis in der Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Audits, Inspektionen und internen Begehungen, idealerweise gemäss ISO 14001 \/ ISO 45001 Starke Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenzen für die Unterstützung von Führungskräften, Projektleitenden und Mitarbeitenden in HSE-Belangen Fähigkeit zur Erstellung und Durchführung von Schulungen zu Arbeitssicherheit, Umwelt und Nachhaltigkeit, sowie Analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung im Umgang mit HSE-Kennzahlen, Reporting und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Landessprachen von Vorteil Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden ihre Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Logistikleiter Warenausgang 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Bei Hitachi gestalten wir die Zukunft – mit Präzision, Innovationskraft und einem klaren Fokus auf Qualität. Für unsere Produktionsstätte in Wettingen suchen wir eine engagierte und erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Logistikleiter Warenausgang, die mit Überblick und Verantwortungsbewusstsein den gesamten Versandprozess steuert. descriptionByLocale.it: In Hitachi, stiamo plasmando il futuro con precisione, innovazione e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. Per il nostro stabilimento produttivo a Wettingen, cerchiamo una persona impegnata ed esperta come Responsabile Logistico Merci in Uscita, che gestisca l'intero processo di spedizione con una panoramica e un senso di responsabilità. In questo ruolo chiave, garantirai che i nostri prodotti raggiungano i nostri clienti puntualmente, completi e in perfette condizioni – e quindi contribuiranno in modo decisivo all'affidabilità della consegna e alla soddisfazione del cliente. Cosa puoi fare Gestione e coordinamento di tutte le attività in uscita, inclusi prelievo, confezione, carico e spedizione Ottimizzazione dei processi di magazzinaggio e logistica in uscita per aumentare l'efficienza e ridurre i costi Leadership, motivazione e ulteriore sviluppo del team uscente Garantire la conformità agli standard di qualità, alle normative di sicurezza e ai requisiti legali Responsabilità per l'accuratezza dell'inventario nel reparto merci in uscita Merci in uscita e gestione regolare degli inventari. Stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti interni (produzione, acquisti, vendite), nonché con partner logistici esterni e spedizionieri. Analisi delle figure chiave rilevanti e preparazione di rapporti sulle prestazioni delle merci in uscita, identificazione e implementazione del potenziale di miglioramento, nonché introduzione di nuove tecnologie, garantire una gestione fluida delle formalità doganali ed esportazione. Il tuo background: Formazione completata in logistica, gestione della catena di approvvigionamento o una qualifica comparabile (ad esempio specialista logistico con un indirizzo federale. Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in posizioni manageriali nel settore merci in uscita o logistica, idealmente in un'azienda manifatturiera Solida conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione magazzino (WMS) e dei sistemi ERP (ad esempio SAP) Esperienza nella guida di team e forti abilità sociali Solide capacità analitiche e concettuali nonché alto livello di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e capacità di problem solving Fluente in tedesco scritto e parlato (Il tedesco svizzero è un vantaggio) e buone competenze in inglese Familiarità con le normative svizzere sulle esportazioni e le dogane Flessibilità negli orari di lavoro se necessario Maggiori informazioni sui nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere Versione tedesca sotto Responsabile della Logistica Outbound 80–100% (f\/m\/d) Informazioni sulla posizione Presso Hitachi, Stiamo plasmando il futuro—con precisione, forza innovativa e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. In questo ruolo chiave, vi assicurate che i nostri prodotti raggiungano i clienti puntualmente, in condizioni complete e in perfette condizioni—contribuendo in modo decisivo all'affidabilità della consegna e alla soddisfazione del cliente. jobs.title: R&D Electrical Validation Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   In our Product evaluation and qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, we make sure to get to the bottom of things and deliver faultless robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a rigorous qualification process. Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility. For the extension and strengthening of our testing activities, we look for a highly motivated  R&D Electrical Validation Engineer.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams Evaluate the performance of new platforms through electrical testing Execute and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality Analyze test data and provide technical recommendations Write and review test reports to communicate the key findings to project stakeholders Contribute to continuous improvement of testing activities for customer satisfaction Adhere to safety rules, environmental protection, and laboratory cleanliness and order Your background     Master's degree, or PhD in electrical engineering or a related field with a focus on semiconductor devices or power electronics Few years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in an R&D environment. Solid understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit design, and analysis. Familiarity with CAD software for electrical design (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad). Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies. Proficiency in modern software tools (Python, LabView, CAD software, statistical data analysis tools) Fluency in English (written and spoken) More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

• Requisiti - Laurea magistrale o dottorato in ingegneria elettrica o campo correlato con focus su dispositivi a semiconduttore o elettronica di potenza - Pochi anni di espérienza in ingegneria elettrica, preferibilemente in un ambiente R&D - Solida comprensione dei principi di ingegneria elettrica, progettazione dei circuiti e analisi - Familiarità con il logiciel CAD per la progettazione elettrica (ad esempio Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad) - Esperienza con l'attrezzatura di laboratorio come oscilloscopi, multimetri e alimentatori - Padronanza di strumenti software moderni (Python, LabView, logiciel CAD, strumenti di analisi dei dati statistici) - Fluente inglese (scritto e parlato)
• Cosa offriamo - Condizioni di lavoro flessibili - Dedicata de mentorat - Ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui puoi crescere personalmente e professionalmente - dandoti la possibilità di prosperare mentre bilanci lavoro e vita Contatto [Contatto non spécifique nel testo originale]

jobs.title: HSE Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy come professionista HSE e gioca un ruolo chiave nella guida di una forte salute, sicurezza e cultura ambientale nelle nostre operazioni di fabbrica a Zurigo. Potrai collaborare strettamente con i team di leadership e interfunzionali per garantire la conformità, minimizzare i rischi e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni HSE, supportando operazioni sostenibili e sicure. Come si fa un impatto - Assicurare il rispetto delle normative HSE, delle politiche interne e degli standard Hitachi Energy in tutta la fabbrica - Condurre valutazioni dei rischi, audit e ispezioni per identificare i rischi e definire azioni di mitigazione - Guidare le indagini sugli incidenti e attuare misure correttive e preventive efficaci - Monitorare i KPI HSE, preparare i report e supportare il processo decisionale basato sui dati - Offrire e coordinare sessioni di formazione HSE, promuovendo la consapevolezza e le migliori pratiche - Sostenere gli audit interni, esterni e di certificazione, assicurando tempestive azioni di follow-up - Collaborare con team interfunzionali e stakeholder esterni per integrare HSE nelle operazioni quotidiane - Guidare iniziative HSE e programmi di miglioramento ambientale (ad esempio rifiuti, acqua, energia) Il tuo sfondo - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza HSE in un ambiente industriale o energetico - Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze Ambientali, Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro, o campo simile - Professionista certificato HSE secondo la legislazione svizzera (obbligatorio) - Forte conoscenza degli standard ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 e HSE - Esperienza comprovata nella valutazione dei rischi, nell'analisi degli incidenti e nel reporting delle prestazioni - Forte capacità di comunicazione e formazione con la capacità di influenzare i comportamenti - mentalità analitica, proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con uno stile di lavoro collaborativo - Fluente in tedesco e inglese; ulteriore competenza in ergonomia o materiali pericolosi è un plus Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. How You'll Make an Impact - Ensure compliance with HSE regulations, internal policies, and Hitachi Energy standards across the factory - Conduct risk assessments, audits, and inspections to identify hazards and define mitigation actions - Drive incident investigations and implement effective corrective and preventive measures - Monitor HSE KPIs, prepare reports, and support data-driven decision-making - Deliver and coordinate HSE training sessions while promoting awareness and best practices - Support internal, external, and certification audits, ensuring timely follow-up actions - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders to integrate HSE into daily operations - Lead HSE initiatives and environmental improvement programs (e.g. waste, water, energy) Your Background - Minimum 5 years of HSE experience in an industrial or energy environment - Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or similar field - Certified HSE professional according to Swiss legislation (mandatory) - Strong knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and HSE Swiss regulations - Proven experience in risk assessments, incident analysis, and performance reporting - Strong communication and training skills with the ability to influence behaviors - Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with a collaborative working style - Fluent in German and English; additional expertise in ergonomics or hazardous materials is a plus More about us - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit gehört Hitachi Energy als HSE-Profi und spielt eine wichtige Rolle bei der Förderung einer starken Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umweltkultur in unserem Werksbetrieb in Zürich. Sie werden eng mit Führungs- und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um die Einhaltung zu gewährleisten, Risiken zu minimieren und die HSE-Leistung kontinuierlich zu verbessern und nachhaltige und sichere Operationen zu unterstützen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der HSE-Verordnungen, der internen Richtlinien und der Hitachi-Energiestandards im gesamten Werk - Durchführung von Risikobewertungen, Prüfungen und Inspektionen zur Identifizierung von Gefahren und zur Festlegung von Minderungsmaßnahmen - Einleitung von Untersuchungen und Durchführung wirksamer Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmen - Überwachen Sie HSE-KPIs, erstellen Sie Berichte und unterstützen Sie datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung - Führen und koordinieren HSE-Trainingssitzungen und fördern das Bewusstsein und die besten Praktiken - Unterstützung interner, externer und Zertifizierungsaudits, um rechtzeitige Folgemaßnahmen zu gewährleisten - Mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und externen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um HSE in den täglichen Betrieb zu integrieren - Lead HSE-Initiativen und Umweltverbesserungsprogramme (z.B. Abfall, Wasser, Energie) Ihr Hintergrund - Mindestens 5 Jahre HSE-Erfahrung in industrieller oder energiereicher Umgebung - Grad in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften, Arbeitsmedizin und Sicherheit oder ähnliches Gebiet - Zertifizierter HSE-Profi nach Schweizer Rechtsvorschriften (obligatorisch) - Starkes Wissen über ISO 14001 und ISO 45001 Standards und HSE Swiss Regulations - Erfahrungen in Risikobewertungen, Vorfallanalysen und Leistungsberichterstattung - Starke Kommunikations- und Trainingsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Verhaltensweisen zu beeinflussen - Analytische, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit einem kollaborativen Arbeitsstil - Fluent in Deutsch und Englisch; zusätzliches Know-how in Ergonomie oder gefährlichen Materialien ist ein Plus Mehr über uns - Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione The Opportunity Rejoignez Hitachi Energy en tant que professionnel HSE et jouez un rôle clé dans la promotion d'une solide culture de la santé, de la sécurité et de l'environnement au sein de nos usines de Zurich. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de direction et des équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'assurer la conformité, de minimiser les risques et d'améliorer continuellement le rendement en matière de SSE tout en soutenant des opérations durables et sécuritaires. Comment vous ferez un impact - Assurer le respect des normes HSE, des politiques internes et Hitachi Energy dans toute l'usine - Effectuer des évaluations des risques, des vérifications et des inspections pour identifier les dangers et définir les mesures d'atténuation - Lancer des enquêtes sur les incidents et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces - Surveiller les ICR HSE, préparer des rapports et appuyer la prise de décisions fondées sur les données - Organiser et coordonner des séances de formation sur l'ESS tout en favorisant la sensibilisation et les meilleures pratiques - Appuyer les audits internes, externes et de certification, en assurant le suivi en temps opportun - Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des intervenants externes pour intégrer le HSE dans les opérations quotidiennes - Diriger les initiatives en matière d'EST et les programmes d'amélioration de l'environnement (p. ex. déchets, eau, énergie) Vos antécédents - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience HSE dans un environnement industriel ou énergétique - Diplôme en génie, sciences de l'environnement, santé et sécurité au travail ou domaine similaire - Professionnel certifié HSE selon la législation suisse (obligatoire) - Forte connaissance des normes ISO 14001 et ISO 45001 et de la réglementation suisse HSE - Expérience éprouvée en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'analyse des incidents et de rapports sur le rendement - Fortes compétences en communication et en formation avec la capacité d'influencer les comportements - Un état d'esprit analytique, proactif et axé sur la solution avec un style de travail collaboratif - Fluent en allemand et en anglais; une expertise supplémentaire en ergonomie ou matières dangereuses est un plus Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Kaufmännischer Projektmanager – Transformatoren 80 – 100 % (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem internationalen Team spannende Projekte im Bereich Transformatoren realisieren? Du bringst Erfahrung im kundenorientierten und kostenoptimierten Projektmanagement mit und möchtest aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung eines dynamischen Umfelds beitragen? Bereit, die Zukunft mitzugestalten – idealerweise im süddeutschen Raum? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Das kannst du bewirken Verantwortung für mittlere bis große Projekte im Transformatorengeschäft Steuerung und Überwachung der Projektanforderungen, einschließlich Zeitplänen, Dokumentation, Projektoptimierungen, Kostenkontrolle, Projektzielen und Risikobewertungen Klärung technischer Details mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern nach Auftragseingang Zentrale Ansprechperson für die interne und externe Projektkommunikation, sowohl gegenüber Kunden als auch dem Produktionsstandort Sicherstellung eines erfolgreichen Projektabschlusses gemäß vertraglichen Bedingungen und internen Richtlinien Verantwortung für Claim- und Reklamationsmanagement zur Minimierung potenzieller Geschäftsrisiken Dein Hintergrund Studium der Elektrotechnik, des Maschinenbaus oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im komplexen Projektmanagement, idealerweise mit mehreren parallellaufenden Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Transformatoren, Kenntnisse in der Hochspannungstechnik sind von Vorteil Erfahrung im Claim- und Risikomanagement Gute Kenntnisse im Vertragsrecht Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist von Vorteil Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) ist ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.   --- English translation below --- Commercial Project Manager – Transformers 80 – 100% (f\/m\/d)   The opportunity Would you like to deliver exciting transformer projects as part of an international team? Do you bring experience in customer-focused and cost-optimized project management and want to actively contribute to the development of a dynamic environment? Ready to help shape the future? Then apply now! How you'll make an impact Responsibility for medium to large projects in the transformer business Management and monitoring of project requirements including schedules, documentation, project optimizations, cost control, project objectives, and risk assessments Clarification of technical details with customers and internal stakeholders following order placement Acting as the central point of contact for internal and external project communication, both with customers and production site Ensuring successful project completion in accordance with contractual conditions and internal guidelines Ownership of claims and complaint management to prevent potential business risks Your background Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable field At least 8 years of experience in project management, ideally involving multiple parallel projects In-depth knowledge in transformers, knowledge in High Voltage technology is a plus Experience in claims and risk management Solid understanding of contract law Fluency in German and English, French is a plus Project management certification (e.g. IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Porti esperienza nella gestione di progetti orientata al cliente e ottimizzata ai costi e vuoi contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo di un ambiente dinamico? Pronto a contribuire a plasmare il futuro? Allora candidati ora! Come avere un impatto: Responsabilità per progetti di medie e grandi dimensioni nel business Transformer, Gestione e monitoraggio dei requisiti del progetto, inclusi tempistiche, documentazione, ottimizzazioni del progetto, controllo dei costi, obiettivi del progetto e valutazioni dei rischi, Chiarimento dei dettagli tecnici con clienti e stakeholder interni dopo l'inserimento degli ordini, Agire come punto di contatto centrale per la comunicazione interna ed esterna del progetto, sia con i clienti che con il sito di produzione, assicurando il completamento con successo del progetto in conformità con le condizioni contrattuali e le linee guida interne, proprietà dei sinistri e gestione dei reclami per prevenire potenziali rischi aziendali. jobs.description:
Über die Position Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitern bietet Hitachi Energy eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios. Darunter; Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Turn-Off-Thyristoren (GTOs), Integrated Gate-Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs), Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistors (IGBTs) und MOSFETs -, die in Industrie, Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbaren Energien für ihre hohe Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit geschätzt werden. Für unser Team suchen wir befristet eine\/n Automatiker\/in, der\/die beim Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme unserer Leistungshalbleiter-Testsysteme mitwirkt. Das kannst du bewirken Aufbau von Leistungshalbleiter-Testsystemen inklusive Mechanik, Elektrik, Pneumatik und Hydraulik Durchführung von Anpassungsarbeiten an fehlerhaften Konstruktionen, Fertigungsteilen oder Schemen Kontrolle aller mechanischen, pneumatischen, elektrischen, programmierten und hydraulischen Funktionen Durchführung von Erdungsmessungen (Überprüfung der Durchgängigkeit des Schutzleitersystems nach EN 60204-1 18b) Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Isolationskoordinationsprotokollen Durchführung der Inbetriebnahme und Isolationskoordination von Testsystemen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Normvorgaben Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen und Systemen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Automatiker\/in EFZ (evtl. mit höherer Fachschule), idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung in der Montage Erfahrung im Projektmanagement Fundiertes Know-how in der mechanischen Bearbeitung von Materialien (Drehen, Fräsen, Bohren, Sägen etc.) Vertrautheit mit Leistungshalbleitern, Messtechnik sowie relevanten Richtlinien und Normen Sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Befristete Position in einem international führenden Hightech-Unternehmen Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   
• We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

Descrizione Hitachi Energy est un leader mondial dans le domaine de l'énergie et des technologies renouvelables qui permet aux clients des services publics et de l'industrie d'améliorer leurs performances tout en réduisant l'impact environnemental. CHSEM fournit des dispositifs semi-conducteurs de haute puissance aux clients internes d'Hitachi Energy (p. ex. HVDC, GPQSS) ainsi qu'aux clients externes. Le Senior Material Quality Engineer assure la qualité, la robustesse et la fiabilité à long terme des matières premières critiques utilisées dans la production de semi-conducteurs BiMOS à l'usine de fabrication de Lenzburg. Agissant en tant qu'autorité technique, ce rôle gère de manière indépendante des sujets complexes liés à la qualité des matériaux et des fournisseurs, contribue à la stratégie de qualité des fournisseurs et soutient le développement des capacités des fournisseurs et des équipes pour permettre des opérations stables et évolutives. Mansioni - Conduire l'approche de qualité des matières premières critiques utilisées dans les opérations BiMOS - Définir et améliorer continuellement les concepts de CTQ et les stratégies de contrôle - Mener des enquêtes complexes sur la qualité des matériaux liées aux écarts, au rendement et à la fiabilité - Surveiller et développer le rendement des fournisseurs et assurer la mise en oeuvre efficace des mesures correctives - Qualification du matériel principal, requalification et gestion du changement - Soutenir la production avec une expertise technique pendant les phases de production, de dépannage et de montée en charge - Lancer des initiatives d'amélioration interfonctionnelles pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité et le rapport coût-efficacité - Agir comme référence technique, soutenir ou encadrer les ingénieurs et renforcer les capacités des fournisseurs et des équipes
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences des matériaux, chimie, physique ou domaine connexe - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la qualité des matériaux, la qualité des fournisseurs ou la fabrication de semi-conducteurs - Auditeur certifié (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011 ou équivalent) - Forte connaissance de la qualité des matériaux, du contrôle des procédés et de la gestion des risques dans un environnement manufacturier - Capacité éprouvée de gérer indépendamment les problèmes complexes de qualité des matériaux et des fournisseurs - Expérience avec des méthodes de qualité structurées telles que 8D, Six Sigma, ou équivalent
• Cosa offriamo - Jours de congé supplémentaires entre Noël et le Nouvel An - Repas subventionnés sur place avec cantines - Remise de 50% sur les cours principaux de nos réfrigérateurs FELFEL - Réduction sur les abonnements dans divers centres de fitness - Réductions sur différents produits et services - Prestations de retraite attractives avec notre fonds de pension d'entreprise - Diversité : promotion de la diversité et de l'inclusion - Offres culturelles, cartes de crédit, essence, etc.)
