jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Zur Verstärkung unserer Front-End-Sales-Organisation suchen wir einen Head of Bid & Proposal, der eine zentrale Rolle im Verkaufsteam Schweiz übernimmt. In dieser Funktion verantworten Sie das Bid Management sowie die Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger und wettbewerbsfähiger Angebote für unser Portfolio von Hochspannungsprodukten und Transformatoren. Sie entwickeln das Bid-&-Proposal-Team weiter und führen es fachlich wie disziplinarisch. Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie sämtliche relevanten internen Stakeholder und tragen mit termingerechten, qualitativ überzeugenden Angeboten massgeblich zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung des Schweizer Marktes bei. Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zielerreichung und im Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams in einem dynamischen Wachstumsumfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Bid-&-Proposal- sowie Order-Handling-Teams mit klarer Ausrichtung auf Wachstum und Geschäftsergebnisse im Einklang mit der Hitachi-Energy-Strategie Weiterentwicklung von Kompetenzen, Strukturen und Prozessen zur Sicherstellung eines leistungsfähigen, motivierten und engagierten Teams Gesamtverantwortung für Angebotsprozesse und Auftragsabwicklung im Produktgeschäft für den Schweizer Markt – termingerecht, qualitäts- und kundengerecht Sicherstellung der fristgerechten, korrekten und regelkonformen Angebotsabgabe gemäss Kunden-, Vertrags- und internen 
• Anforderungen Entwicklung und Steuerung von Angebotsstrategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal sowie den Werken Aktive Gestaltung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Vertrieb, Engineering und Produktion sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Angebotsmanagement‑Prozesse Vorleben der Hitachi-Energy-Werte, insbesondere Sicherheit und Integrität Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor\/Master) im technischen oder ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich; betriebswirtschaftliche Zusatzqualifikation von Vorteil Mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, Bid & Proposal oder Projektmanagement Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Führung oder Koordination von Teams sowie im Management komplexer Stakeholder‑Strukturen Branchenkenntnisse im Energiesektor sowie ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung Tiefes Verständnis von Ausschreibungs‑ und Auftragsabwicklungsprozessen, inkl. SAP‑Grundlagen, kaufmännischer Abläufe, Vertragsverhandlungen, Risiko‑ sowie Claims‑Management Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, Team-Player Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil Mehr über uns Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, engagierten und kollaborativen Umfeld Klare Förderung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch strukturierte Lern- und Entwicklungsangebote Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt Eine einzigartige Kultur: Bringen Sie Ihre Persönlichkeit, Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihre Ideen ein und gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft Flexible Arbeitsmodelle inkl. Hybrid‑ und Remote‑Optionen Attraktives, wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungs‑ und Leistungspaket

descriptionByLocale.it:
# Mansioni # - Responsabilità del Bid Management e della creazione di offerte di alta qualità e competitive per il nostro portafoglio di prodotti ad alta tensione e trasformari - Sviluppo e guida del team Bid & Propost e Order Handling, con un focus sul development e sui risultati aziendali in linea con la strategia Hitachi Energy - Coordinamento di tutti i stakeholder interni precedenti per garantire l'organizzazione tempestiva, di alta qualità e in linea con le esigenze del cliente delle offerte - Sviluppo delle competenze, delle strutture e dei processi per garantire un team performante, motivato e impegnato - Responsabilità completa per i processi di offerta e l'esecuzione degli ordini nel business dei prodotti per il mercato svizzero, nel rispetto dei tempi, della qualità e delle esigenze del cliente - Garanzia del rispetto dei termini, della correttezza e del rispetto delle regole per le offerte in conformità a tutte le richieste del cliente, ai contratti e all normative interne - Sviluppo e gestione delle strategie di offerta in collaborazione con Market Management, Area Sales, Key Account Management, Contract Management & Legal e i siti di produzione - Gestione efficiente delle barriere tra vendite, ingegneria e produzione e miglioramento continuo dei processi di gestione delle offerte - Rappresentanza dei valori Hitachi Energy, in particolare sicurezza e apparenza #
• Requisiti # - Laurea triennale o magistrale in ambito tecnico o ingegneristico; preferibile formazione complementare in ambito economico - Almeno 10 anni di esperienza nel campo delle vendite tecniche, Bid & Propost o project management - Esperienza comprovata nella guida o nella coordinamento di team e nella gestione di strutture complesse di stakeholder - Conoscenza del settore energetico e forte orientamento al cliente - Profonda comprensione dei processi di gara e di esecuzione degli ordini, inclusi i fondamenti di SAP, i processi amministrativi, le minacce contrattuali, la gestione del rischio e dei fattori - Ottime capacità comunicative, lavoro autonomo e proattivo, spirito di squadra - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia in parlato che in scritto; il francese o l'italiano sono un vantaggio Traduzione: - Lavoro vario e responsabile in un ambiente dinamico, impegnato e collaborativo - Sostegno allo sviluppo delle competenze e delle capacità personali attraverso l'offerta di formazione e sviluppo strutturate - Cultura aziendale che apprezza la collaborazione, la diversità e le diverse prospettive - Unica cultura: porti la tua personalità, la tua passione e le do idee e contribuisci con noi a un futuro energetico sostenibile - Modelli di lavoro flessibili, inclusi

jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Strategic Buyer – Direct Materials 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale vi aspetta. Si può aspettare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere in esso. Senior così come le applicazioni junior sono benvenuti! Mansioni - Gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV - 550KV. - Responsabile per la riuscita dell'esecuzione dell'installazione/manutenzione/riparazioni in loco in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e nel rispetto dei requisiti legali locali. - Responsabile per la qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo della qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale. - Condurre la formazione del prodotto in loco sul prodotto e durante l'installazione (opzionale). - Coordinamento del lavoro locale. - Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto. - Contribuire attivamente ai miglioramenti del processo e adottare proattivamente misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco.
• Requisiti - Apprendistato completo nella costruzione di metalli, nell'industria elettrica o automobilistica, o simili - La conoscenza di base in ingegneria elettrica è un must desiderabile, ulteriore formazione in ingegneria elettrica è un vantaggio - L'esperienza lavorativa nel montaggio e messa in servizio è un vantaggio - Buone competenze in tedesco e inglese, almeno B2 - Volontà per incarichi nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con un tempo di viaggio fino al 90% - Giocatore di squadra flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo - Flair per soluzioni pragmatiche e non convenzionali con elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza Cosa? - Attività emozionanti e varie con grande libertà creativa - Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo interessanti - Attività/progetti interessanti e molto varie, inclusi incarichi off-shore - Team ben consolidato e dinamico - Cultura aziendale aperta - Un pacchetto di benefici interessanti che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, nonché una voce nella scelta di alloggio

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. L'unité de service est responsable de l'appui après vente dans le monde entier des systèmes de disjoncteurs de générateurs (GCB) et des commutateurs isolés de gaz (GIS), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, l'entretien programmé, les services à valeur ajoutée, le dépannage, les extensions, les mises à niveau et les remplacements. Après une formation polyvalente et pratique en Suisse et à l'étranger, vous dirigerez de nouvelles installations SIG à travers le monde. Une position techniquement difficile dans un environnement multiculturel vous attend. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et s'y développer. Les candidatures senior et junior sont les bienvenues! jobs.title: Internship Production Development 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. jobs.description: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

Mansioni - Contribuer au développement de puces semi-conducteurs de nouvelle génération, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les diodes de puissance au silicium et les technologies connexes - Soutenir le cycle de développement de la technologie et des produits de bout en bout, du concept et de la simulation à l'évaluation de la validation et de la fiabilité - Appliquer et développer des modèles de simulation TCAD pour comprendre le comportement de l'appareil et optimiser les performances, le rendement et le coût - Collaborer étroitement avec les ingénieurs de process, les équipes de caractérisation et de fiabilité, en assurant l'alignement entre conception et fabrication - Prendre en charge les travaux individuels ou les sous-projets, contribuant ainsi aux objectifs et aux échéanciers globaux du projet - Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des méthodes d'analyse, de modélisation et d'optimisation fondées sur les données - Contribuer activement au partage des connaissances au sein de l'équipe et développer une solide compréhension au niveau des systèmes des dispositifs et procédés à semi-conducteurs
• Requisiti - Maîtrise ou doctorat en physique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe, mettant l'accent sur la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs - Expérience éprouvée dans le développement de dispositifs semi-conducteurs de puissance, idéalement avec l'exposition aux diodes de puissance en silicium - Forte expérience pratique avec les outils de simulation TCAD (par exemple Sentaurus, COMSOL) - Bonne compréhension de la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, des caractéristiques et des processus de développement technologique - Exposition à une collaboration interfonctionnelle avec des équipes de processus, de caractérisation et de fiabilité - L'expérience initiale dans la possession de tâches techniques ou la supervision de profils juniors est un plus - La connaissance des aspects d'intégration des processus ou des approches de modélisation est considérée comme un avantage - Autodidacte, analytique et désireux d'apprendre et de grandir dans un environnement de R-D performant - Maîtrise de l'anglais avec de solides compétences en communication et présentation Contatto

jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.title: Produktionsmitarbeiter/in Montage 80–100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Montagefachkraft in der Produktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Fertigung unserer Produkte. Du richtest Produktionsanlagen ein, führst Montagearbeiten durch und stellst sicher, dass alle Arbeitsschritte gemäss Vorgaben hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Dank deiner Erfahrung erkennst du Abweichungen frühzeitig, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse sowie die Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Montage- und Produktionsarbeiten gemäss Spezifikationen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Qualitätsstandards Einrichten, Bedienen und Überwachen von Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsmitteln Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Produktionsablaufs unter Einhaltung von Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätsvorgaben Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen sowie Identifikation, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen Bewegen, Sortieren und Verpacken von Materialien und Fertigprodukten Dokumentation von Produktionsdaten zur Unterstützung der Leistungsanalyse Unterstützung bei der Optimierung von Prozessen sowie Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen Fachliche Unterstützung und Einarbeitung von weniger erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene technische\/handwerkliche Berufsausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung in der Produktion Mehrjährige Erfahrung im industriellen Produktionsumfeld, idealerweise in Montage oder Fertigung Gute Kenntnisse von Produktionsprozessen, Arbeitsabläufen und Werkzeugen Fähigkeit, auch bei komplexeren Problemen strukturiert Lösungen zu erarbeiten Selbstständige, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wissen weiterzugeben Bereitschaft in 2-Schicht Betrieb zu arbeiten Mehr über uns   Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: Come specialista di assemblaggio in produzione, si gioca un ruolo centrale nella produzione dei nostri prodotti. L'installazione di impianti di produzione, l'esecuzione di lavori di assemblaggio e l'assicurarsi che tutte le fasi di lavoro siano eseguite in conformità con i requisiti in materia di qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Grazie alla vostra esperienza, riconoscete le deviazioni in anticipo, analizzate le cause e sostenete attivamente il continuo miglioramento dei processi produttivi e l'integrazione di nuovi dipendenti. Questo consente di eseguire lavori di assemblaggio e produzione secondo specifiche, istruzioni di lavoro e standard di qualità Installazione, gestione e monitoraggio di impianti di produzione e attrezzature di lavoro Assicurare un processo di produzione regolare, mantenendo il tempo, i costi e le specifiche di qualità Applicazione dei controlli di qualità, nonché l'identificazione, l'analisi e la correzione di deviazioni Spostamento, smistamento e imballaggio di materiali e prodotti finiti Documentazione dei dati di produzione per supportare l'analisi delle prestazioni Questo ti porta a lavorare con una completa esperienza tecnica e artigianale o professionale comparabile nella produzione Esperienza pluriennale nell'ambiente di produzione industriale, idealmente nell'assemblaggio o nella produzione Buona conoscenza dei processi di produzione, dei flussi di lavoro e degli strumenti Capacità di sviluppare soluzioni strutturate anche in problemi complessi Lavoro autonomo, affidabile e di qualità-consapevole Funzionamento delle competenze del Team, nonché la volontà di assumersi responsabilità e trasmettere conoscenze in funzionamento a 2 turni.
descriptionByLocale.en: As an assembly specialist in production, you play a central role in the production of our products. You set up production facilities, perform assembly work and make sure that all work steps are carried out in accordance with requirements regarding quality, efficiency and safety. Thanks to your experience, you recognize deviations early, analyze causes and actively support the continuous improvement of production processes and the incorporation of new employees. This allows you to perform assembly and production work according to specifications, work instructions and quality standards Set up, operate and monitor production facilities and work equipment Ensure a smooth production process while maintaining time, cost and quality specifications Implementation of quality controls as well as identification, analysis and correction of deviations Moving, sorting and packaging of materials and finished products Documentation of production data to support performance analysis This brings you to work with completed technical & craftsmanship or comparable professional experience in production Multiannual experience in industrial production environment, ideally in assembly or manufacturing Good knowledge of production processes, workflows and tools Ability to develop structured solutions even in complex problems Self-employed, reliable and quality-conscious functioning Team skills as well as the willingness to take responsibility and pass on knowledge in 2-shift operation More about us We are looking for a safe workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and value-adding working environment and attractive social benefits.

descriptionByLocale.fr: En tant que spécialiste de la production, vous jouez un rôle central dans la production de nos produits. Vous créez des installations de production, effectuez des travaux d'assemblage et assurez-vous que toutes les étapes de travail sont effectuées conformément aux exigences en matière de qualité, d'efficacité et de sécurité. Grâce à votre expérience, vous reconnaissez les écarts tôt, analysez les causes et soutenez activement l'amélioration continue des processus de production et l'intégration de nouveaux employés. Cela vous permet d'effectuer des travaux de montage et de production selon les spécifications, les instructions de travail et les normes de qualité Configurer, exploiter et surveiller les installations de production et les équipements de travail Assurer un processus de production fluide tout en maintenant le temps, les coûts et les spécifications de qualité Mise en œuvre des contrôles de qualité ainsi que l'identification, l'analyse et la correction des écarts Déplacement, tri et emballage des matériaux et des produits finis Documentation des données de production pour soutenir l'analyse des performances Cela vous amène à travailler avec un savoir-faire technique & ou une expérience professionnelle comparable dans la production Expérience pluriannuelle dans l'environnement de production industrielle, idéalement dans l'assemblage ou la fabrication Bonne connaissance des processus de production, des workflows et des outils Capacité de développer des solutions structurées même dans des problèmes complexes Travailleur indépendant, fiable et soucieux de la qualité Compétences de l'équipe ainsi que la volonté d'assumer la responsabilité et de transmettre des connaissances dans l'exploitation de 2 équipes Plus sur nous Nous cherchons un lieu de travail sûr dans une entreprise tournée vers l'avenir, des possibilités de développement passionnantes, un environnement de travail collégial et enrichissant et des avantages sociaux attrayants.

jobs.title: R&D and Production Engineering Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Business R&D team in Turgi, where we develop cutting-edge medium-voltage frequency converters and HVDC subsystems. You'll work in a collaborative environment with six power electronics engineers and three mechanical engineers, contributing to innovative solutions that have a global impact. This position combines 60% R&D and 40% production engineering, offering flexibility for research activities and hands-on involvement in manufacturing processes. How you'll make an impact   •  Research & Development (60%) Drive innovation in medium-voltage converter design and technology Develop and build from prototype until the final product Collaborate with global teams in Poland, Sweden, India and China Work arrangement: Flexible (remote or on-site as needed)   •  Production Engineering (40%) Ensure seamless integration of designs into manufacturing processes Optimize production workflows for efficiency and quality Provide technical support to production teams and troubleshoot issues Work arrangement: On-site presence required at our factories in Turgi and Seon Lead & implement lean management and CIP methodology   Your background   Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field Experience in power electronics and converter technology Experience in mechanical design and development, with tools like SolidEdge, NX, SAP Knowledge of production processes and industrialization Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Fluent in English and German   What We Offer Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. We also offer you: Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers Numerous exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Discounted conditions in our daycare centres in Baden and Oerlikon Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidized meals at locations with canteens Discounts on memberships at various fitness centers Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more

jobs.title: Global SCM Training Leader, BU Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Training Leader for the Business Unit Transformers to join our global training and supply chain community. In this role, you will define and drive the strategic direction, development, and deployment of Supply Chain Management (SCM) training programs across the business unit. You will play a key role in strengthening supply chain capabilities, enabling business performance, and supporting standardization, transformation, and continuous improvement across regions and functions. jobs.title: High Voltage Testing Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Project Manager to strengthen our Team in our Business Unit Transformers, Ticino. In this role you are leading the execution of medium-size projects mainly related to LV & MV Transformers and Reactors and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policy, quality standards, health & safety and environment requirements. Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Please submit your resume in English. How you'll make an impact Developing project schedules, and determining resource requirements Monitoring and reporting on the status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing Ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards (e.g., International Standards Organization) Manage After-Sales projects by ensuring the fulfillment of customer needs Identifying\/resolving obstacles to completing project on time and to budget May include work managing multiple, interrelated projects (including business transformation projects) On some projects, the work may include integrating vendor tasks into the project plan and tracking and reviewing vendor deliverables Your background Electrical Engineering or mechanical Engineering Background 2-3 years proven experience in Project Management with focus on Transformers and Reactors Collaboration with diverse number of stakeholders Very good knowledge of English and Italian; any other languages are a plus Strong communicator, self-driven and open-minded Structured and organized person with the ability to work under time pressure Team-player able to build and motivate a project team More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: System Engineer (SCADA/RTU) for Substation Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'opportunità Per rafforzare il nostro team di ingegneri, stiamo cercando un System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) per lavorare sui sistemi di controllo e protezione nel campo delle sottostazioni di rete elettrica. L'apertura, l'orientamento del cliente e l'innovazione sono fattori chiave di successo nel nostro ambiente di lavoro. Dovresti essere un giocatore di squadra che collabora a diversi livelli organizzativi in un ambiente interculturale. Se ti piace combinare competenze tecniche con un forte focus del cliente, questa è un'opportunità per te! I professionisti della cura precoce sono anche benvenuti da applicare. Benvenuti nella nostra squadra! Come farai ad avere un impatto In questa posizione impegnativa, si progettano sistemi di controllo sottostazione (SCADA) per switchgear ad alta e media tensione in conformità con gli ultimi standard tecnologici come IEC 61850, IEC 104 e altri protocolli Integrerai i sistemi, inclusa la parametrizzazione della struttura di comunicazione basata su Ethernet Inoltre, implementerai funzioni e applicazioni software specifiche per il progetto, eseguirai test e coordinate interfacce Supportando la messa in loco presso strutture in tutta la Svizzera è anche parte del tuo ruolo Supporterai il project manager in materia tecnica e coordinate sia i clienti che i partner esterni Potrai creare manuali operativi su misura per le esigenze del cliente Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettrica, o una qualifica equivalente Conoscenze di base di sistemi di controllo e protezione, sistemi RTU, o sistemi di automazione di processo è un vantaggio Hai conoscenze di base di sicurezza informatica e architettura di rete Accanto a forti capacità di comunicazione e spirito di squadra, è necessario dimostrare la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere la responsabilità Fluent tedesco (spoken e scritto) è richiesto. Le buone competenze in inglese sono essenziali; lingue aggiuntive come il francese sono un vantaggio Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere. Mansioni - In questa posizione impegnativa, si progettano sistemi di controllo sottostazione (SCADA) per switchgear ad alta e media tensione in conformità con gli ultimi standard tecnologici come IEC 61850, IEC 104 e altri protocolli - Integrerai i sistemi, inclusa la parametrizzazione della struttura di comunicazione basata su Ethernet - Inoltre, si attueranno funzioni specifiche del progetto e applicazioni software, eseguire test e coordinate interfacce - Sostenere la messa in loco presso le strutture in tutta la Svizzera è anche parte del vostro ruolo - Sosterrete il responsabile del progetto in materia tecnica e coordinate sia i clienti che i partner esterni - Crea manuali operativi su misura per le esigenze del cliente
• Requisiti - Laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria elettrica, o una qualifica equivalente - La conoscenza di base dei sistemi di controllo e di protezione, sistemi RTU o sistemi di automazione di processo è un vantaggio - Hai conoscenza di base della sicurezza informatica e dell'architettura di rete - Oltre a forti capacità di comunicazione e spirito di squadra, è necessario dimostrare la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e prendere la responsabilità - Tedesco fluido (spoken e scritto) è richiesto. - Buone competenze in inglese sono essenziali; lingue aggiuntive come il francese sono un vantaggio Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. ## Mansioni - In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols - You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure - Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces - Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role - You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners - You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements ##
• Requisiti - Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification - Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage - You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture - Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility - Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. - Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage ##
• Cosa offriamo - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione L'opportunité Pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénieurs, nous cherchons un ingénieur système (SCADA\/RTU) pour travailler sur les systèmes de contrôle et de protection dans le domaine des sous-stations du réseau électrique. L'ouverture, l'orientation des clients et l'innovation sont des facteurs clés de succès dans notre environnement de travail. Vous devriez être un joueur d'équipe qui collabore à différents niveaux organisationnels dans un environnement interculturel. Si vous aimez combiner l'expertise technique avec une forte concentration client, c'est une opportunité pour vous! Les professionnels en début de carrière sont également invités à postuler. Bienvenue dans notre équipe ! Comment vous ferez un impact Dans cette position difficile, vous concevrez des systèmes de commande sous-station (SCADA) pour les commutateurs à haute et moyenne tension conformément aux dernières normes technologiques telles que IEC 61850, IEC 104 et d'autres protocoles Vous intégrerez les systèmes, y compris la paramétrisation de la structure de communication Ethernet De plus, vous mettrez en œuvre des fonctions spécifiques au projet et des applications logicielles, réaliserez des tests et coordonnerz des interfaces.L'accompagnement de la mise en service sur place dans toute la Suisse fait également partie de votre rôle. Vous créerez des manuels d'exploitation adaptés aux besoins du client Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en ingénierie de l'énergie, génie électrique ou une qualification équivalente Connaissance de base des systèmes de contrôle et de protection, des systèmes RTU, ou des systèmes d'automatisation de processus est un avantage Vous avez une connaissance de base de la cybersécurité et de l'architecture de réseau Outre de solides compétences en communication et l'esprit d'équipe, vous devez démontrer la capacité de travailler en toute indépendance et prendre des responsabilités. De bonnes compétences en anglais sont essentielles; d'autres langues comme le français sont un avantage Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir. Mansioni - Dans cette position difficile, vous concevrez des systèmes de commande sous-station (SCADA) pour les commutateurs à haute et moyenne tension conformément aux dernières normes technologiques telles que IEC 61850, IEC 104 et d'autres protocoles - Vous intégrerez les systèmes, y compris la paramétrisation de la structure de communication Ethernet - En outre, vous mettrez en œuvre des fonctions spécifiques au projet et des applications logicielles, effectuerez des tests et coordonnerz des interfaces - Soutenir la mise en service sur place dans toute la Suisse fait également partie de votre rôle - Vous accompagnerez le responsable de projet en matière technique et coordonnerez les clients et les partenaires internes - Vous créerez des manuels d'exploitation adaptés aux besoins du client
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie de l'énergie, génie électrique ou une qualification équivalente - Connaissance de base des systèmes de contrôle et de protection, des systèmes RTU ou des systèmes d'automatisation des processus est un avantage - Vous avez une connaissance de base de la cybersécurité et de l'architecture de réseau - En plus de solides compétences de communication et d'esprit d'équipe, vous devez démontrer votre capacité à travailler de façon indépendante et à prendre des responsabilités - L'allemand (parlé et écrit) est requis. - De bonnes compétences en anglais sont essentielles; d'autres langues comme le français sont un avantage
• Cosa offriamo - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Troubleshooting Process Quality Technician 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit Der Bereich GIS (Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Funktion in der Bearbeitung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen in der Produktion. Du erkennst Probleme frühzeitig, analysierst sie strukturiert und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen internen Stakeholdern zusammen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse bei. Das kannst du bewirken Du bist die erste Eskalationsstufe für die Produktion und arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen. Verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen (QN) in der Produktion Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Priorisierung von Qualitätsmeldungen (Q-Meldungen) Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering, Planung, Projektleitung und Einkauf Du untersützt die Weiterentwicklung von Troubleshooting Prozessen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Unterstützung bei Audits und internen Reviews Das bringst du mit Technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Qualität Erfahrung im Troubleshooting, Produktionsprozesse oder in Qualitätsmanagement Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Problemlösungskompetenz Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsfähigkeit Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Kenntnisse in SAP und MES Detaillierte Produktkenntnisse im Bereich Gas Isolierte Schaltanlagen Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

titleByLocale.it: Risoluzione dei problemi Tecnologia di qualità del processo 80 - 100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione La gamma GIS (sistemi di commutazione isolati) rappresenta la massima qualità, sicurezza ed efficienza, ed è qui che il vostro ruolo è impostato. In questo ruolo assumete un ruolo centrale nella lavorazione e nel coordinamento dei rapporti di qualità nella produzione. Riconoscete i problemi in una fase iniziale, analizzarli in modo strutturato e garantire soluzioni sostenibili. Lavorate a stretto contatto con varie parti interessate interne e contribuite attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri processi. Mansioni - Sono la prima fase di escalation per la produzione - Lavora a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni - Responsabile per la creazione e il coordinamento dei rapporti di qualità (QN) nella produzione - Garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità e sicurezza - Priorità dei rapporti di qualità (notifiche Q) - Una stretta cooperazione con i dipartimenti interni quali la produzione, la qualità, l'ingegneria, la pianificazione, la gestione dei progetti e l'acquisto - Supporto per audit e recensioni interne
• Requisiti - Formazione tecnica in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, qualità - Esperienza di risoluzione dei problemi, processi di produzione o gestione della qualità - Il pensiero analitico, il lavoro strutturato e l'alta competenza di problem solving - Comunicazione e processo decisionale - competenze in tedesco e inglese - Conoscenza di SAP e MES - Conoscenza dettagliata del prodotto nel settore dei sistemi di commutazione isolati a gas Cosa? - Una cultura che vuole imparare continuamente e plasmare congiuntamente soluzioni energetiche sostenibili - Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo in cui ogni opinione conta e puoi introdurre le tue idee – indipendentemente dall'origine, dal sesso o dallo sfondo - L'opportunità di introdurre le vostre idee ed esperienze e contribuire attivamente all'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri processi Contatto - A Hitachi Energy crediamo nel potere della diversità, della cooperazione e dell'innovazione. La nostra cultura è caratterizzata da un apprendimento continuo e dall'obiettivo comune di modellare soluzioni energetiche sostenibili.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione The GIS range (Gasisolated switching systems) stands for the highest quality, safety and efficiency – and this is where your role is set. In this role you take a central role in the processing and coordination of quality reports in production. You recognize problems at an early stage, analyze them in a structured manner and ensure sustainable solutions. You work closely with various internal stakeholders and actively contribute to the further development of our processes. Mansioni - Are the first escalation stage for production - Works closely with internal stakeholders - Responsible for the creation and coordination of quality reports (QN) in production - Ensuring compliance with quality and safety standards - Priority of quality reports (Q notifications) - Close cooperation with internal departments such as production, quality, engineering, planning, project management and purchasing - Support for audits and internal reviews
• Requisiti - Technical training in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, quality - Troubleshooting experience, production processes or quality management - Analytical thinking, structured working and high problem solving competence - Impressed communication and decision-making - German and English skills - Knowledge of SAP and MES - Detailed product knowledge in the field of gas Insulated switching systems
• Cosa offriamo - A culture that wants to continuously learn and jointly shape sustainable energy solutions - An inclusive working environment where every opinion counts and you can introduce your ideas – regardless of origin, gender or background - The opportunity to introduce your ideas and experiences and actively contribute to the further development of our processes Contatto - At Hitachi Energy we believe in the power of diversity, cooperation and innovation. Our culture is characterized by continuous learning and the common goal of shaping sustainable energy solutions.

jobs.title: R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on  location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated semiconductor production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automation and metal joining technologies. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability and quality of bonding and welding processes, by applying data analysis tools and designed experiments Analyze production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Work on new automated production systems, improving production capacity and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing   Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment, ideally within the semiconductor industry Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:

I nostri prodotti includono tiristori, diodi, tiristori a cancello, tiristori integrati a cancello, transistor bipolari a porte isolate e transistor a effetto campo a semiconduttore metallico. Questi componenti sono affidabili in settori come la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia, la mobilità e l'energia rinnovabile per la loro eccezionale qualità e affidabilità. Mansioni Nel ruolo di Process Engineer per BiMOS Backend, contribuirai all'avanzamento della nostra produzione automatizzata di semiconduttori. Avrete l'opportunità di migliorare i processi produttivi esistenti e di condurre progetti di sviluppo innovativi, con particolare attenzione all'automazione e alle tecnologie di giunzione dei metalli. - Migliorare la capacità e la qualità dei processi di incollaggio e saldatura applicando strumenti di analisi dei dati e esperimenti progettati - Analizzare i dati di produzione per ottimizzare le prestazioni, identificare le tendenze a lungo termine e prevenire potenziali guasti - Lavorare su nuovi sistemi di produzione automatizzati, migliorare la capacità produttiva e la qualità - Supporta la risoluzione dei problemi e l'analisi delle cause radice per mantenere e migliorare la produttività - Collaborare sul nuovo sviluppo del prodotto modellando il paesaggio del processo produttivo e consentendo la produzione di volumi Cosa? Come farai ad avere un impatto
• Requisiti Il tuo sfondo - Laurea magistrale in ingegneria industriale, meccanica, elettrica o chimica, o in un campo correlato - Diversi anni di esperienza in un ambiente di produzione automatizzato, idealmente nell'industria dei semiconduttori - Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, una mentalità focalizzata sulla qualità e un approccio proattivo e pratico - Familiarità con DoE, analisi dei dati, metodologie Six Sigma e statistiche di produzione è un plus - Proficienza sia in tedesco che in inglese Contatto Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Field Service Technician 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity As a Field Service Technician, you will play a key role in maintaining the reliable operation of traction transformers across customer sites and in our factory. You will perform hands-on repairs, diagnose technical issues, and support customers directly. With your practical expertise, you will collaborate closely with internal teams and contribute to continuous product and process improvements. How you'll make an impact Always follow safety standards and company procedures during both field (60%) and factory (40%) activities. Perform on-site repairs and servicing of traction transformers, delivering prompt and professional solutions. Conduct field repairs, electrical diagnostic testing, and oil treatment at customer locations. Support failure investigations through disassembly, root-cause analysis, and the preparation of technical reports. Provide customers with technical support and training on equipment operation and basic maintenance. Contribute to small improvement projects aimed at boosting quality, efficiency, and service processes. Prepare service documentation, including work reports, material usage, quality inspection cards, and repair records. Collaborate with engineering, quality, project management, and sales teams to resolve escalated technical issues. In the factory, ensure effective coordination and execution of repair work alongside the Service team. Your background Completed technical apprenticeship or degree in Electrical\/Electrotechnical\/Maintenance fields. Minimum of 1–2 years of field service or technical repair experience, ideally in an industrial environment. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical cabling diagrams, and schematics. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for solving complex technical problems. Customer-oriented communicator, fluent in English; French is an advantage. Independent, self-driven, and flexible with working hours. Valid driving licence. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

Mansioni - Seguire sempre le standard di sicurezza e le procedures aziendali durant le séjour en campo (60 %) che in fabbrica (40 %). - Eseguire riparazioni e servizi presso i siti dei clienti, fornendo soluzioni rapide e professionali. - Condurre riparazioni in campo, test diagnostici elettrici e trattamenti di olio presso i siti dei clienti. - Supportare le indigini sui guasti attraverso la désassemblage, l'analisi delle cause e la preparazione di rapporti tecnici. - Fornire ai clienti supporto tecnico e formazione sull'uso e la manutenzione delle attrezzature. - Contribuer a piccoli progetti di miglioramento mirati a migliorare la qualità, l'efficacité e i processi di servizio. - Préparer la documentation di servizio, comprendre i rapporti di lavoro, l'uso dei matériali, le schede di ispezione della qualità e i registri di riparazione. - Collaborer avec l'ingegneria, la qualité, la gestione dei progetti e la cupra di vendita per risolvere le questioni tecniche elevate. - En fabbrica, assicurare una coordinazione e un'escuzione efficaci del lavoro di riparazione insieme alla squadra di Servizio.
• Requisiti - Completamento di un apprendistato tecnico o diploma in campi elettrici/elettronici/manutenzione. - Minimo 1-2 anni di espérienza in servizio di campo o riparazione tecnica, idéal dans un ambient industriel. - Capacità di leggere e interpretationare disegni tecnici, diagrammi di cablaggio elettrico e schemi. - Abilità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi complessi per risolvere problemi tecnici. - Comunicatore orientalato ai clienti, parler couramment l'inglese; il francese è un vantaggio. - Indipendente, autodiretto e flessibile con gli orari di lavoro. - Brevet di guida valide.
• Cosa offriamo - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiutano a ottimizzare il tuo rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro concurrente e crescere.

jobs.title: CNC Dreher/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist technischer Marktführer in der Auslegung und Herstellung von Transformatoren-Durchführungen. Zu den Kunden zählen namhafte, internationale Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die sich mit Stromerzeugung, Stromübertragung und Stromverteilung befassen. Unsere Hochspannungs-Durchführungen nehmen weltweit eine Spitzenposition ein.    Das kannst Du bewirken Einrichtung und Bedienung von CNC- und konventionellen Drehmaschinen Erstellen der CNC Programme zu den Dreharbeiten Fertigen von Einzelteilen und Kleinserien Pflege und Wartung (VBI) der Maschinen und Anlagen Diverse 
• Aufgaben wie Qualitätsvorgaben einhalten, kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsprozess, konsequente Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheit   Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Lehre als Polymechaniker\/in EFZ (oder auch Mechaniker\/in, Maschinenmechaniker\/in) Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich CNC-Drehen, konv. von Vorteil Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Exakte, ordentliche Arbeitsweise Bereitschaft zum Einsatz im 3 Schicht-Betrieb und flexibler Arbeitszeit Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

jobs.title: Working Student Defectivity Engineering BIMOS 40% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Are you passionate about semiconductors and eager to gain hands-on experience in industry? We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented student to join our dynamic team for at least 6 months, with the possibility to extend. As a Defectivity Engineering Working Student, you will have the opportunity to work on real-world projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to ensuring the highest standards of our semiconductor product quality here in Lenzburg, Aargau.   How you'll make an impact Assist in identifying optical defects through non-destructive optical inspection  Support defectivity projects through data analysis and reporting on optical yield of our products Support regular maintenance of baseline and Pareto reporting systems Optimize and improve defect portfolio for various products Coordinate with various departments to correlate optical defects with equipment used in manufacturing process Your background Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Materials Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related field Strong teamwork and communication skills Great attention to detail and persistence  Fluency in English, German language skills a plus Hands-on mentality and comfort working in a manufacturing environment More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Installation Project Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit   In dieser Funktion übernimmst du am Standort Oerlikon die Organisation, Koordination und Führung aller Montage-, Inbetriebsetzungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten vor Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Projekte effizient, sicher und mit hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.    Das kannst du bewirken   Verantwortung für die Abwicklung sowie die organisatorische Führung von Arbeiten vor Ort  Ansprechperson für interne und externe Kunden  Betreuung der zugeteilten Aussendienstmitarbeitenden und Erstellung von Montagezeitplänen unter Berücksichtigung von Ressourcen wie Verbrauchsmaterial, Werkzeug und Personal  Überwachung und Dokumentation von Projektfortschritt und - kosten (Reporting)  Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsanforderungen  Aktive Minimierung von Projektkosten und Risiken sowie prozessgerechte Bearbeitung von Abweichungsmeldungen inkl. Einleitung von Korrekturmassnahmen Vollständige Zusammenstellung, Ablage und Archivierung aller relevanten Dokumentationen (Red Marks, Prüfprotokolle, Berichte) zur As-Built-Erstellung sowie Verrechnung an den Kunden    Das bringst du mit   Technische Grundausbildung sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage und\/oder Inbetriebnahme von GIS-Anlagen  Fundiertes technisches Verständnis; Führungserfahrung von Vorteil  Technikerschule \/ Technischer Kaufmann  Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen von Vorteil  Sicheres Auftreten und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, insbesondere in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Kulturen  Teamfähigkeit, Organisationsstärke sowie Durchsetzungsvermögen Bereitschaft zu weltweiten Baustellenbesuchen Gute Kenntnisse in SAP und MS Office​ ​Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy setzen wir auf Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven stärken unsere Innovation und ermöglichen Lösungen, die unsere Energiezukunft nachhaltig prägen. Wenn du Teil eines globalen Teams sein möchtest, das gemeinsam Wirkung erzielt, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Work on cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Collaborative culture with opportunities for career growth and innovation. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. * * Applicable  only for Poland location align with local law regulations

Riconoscete i problemi in una fase iniziale, analizzarli in modo strutturato e garantire soluzioni sostenibili. La nostra cultura è caratterizzata da un apprendimento continuo e dall'obiettivo comune di modellare soluzioni energetiche sostenibili.
