jobs.title: Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. How you'll make an impact Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity  Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge) Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è il leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta potenza. Tutte le rinomate aziende internazionali dell'industria elettrica, attive nella produzione di energia, trasmissione e distribuzione sono tra i nostri clienti. Abbiamo una posizione superiore nelle aree boccole trans-former ad alta tensione in tutto il mondo. In questo ruolo altamente responsabile e dinamico, guiderai il nostro team di laboratorio presso MICAFIL a Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) e ti assicurerai di rafforzare ulteriormente la nostra competitività e sviluppare il nostro ramo svizzero per soddisfare la crescita globale del mercato nel campo dell'energia. In questo ruolo importante, continuerai a guidare i processi efficienti e innovativi dei nostri 3 laboratori diversi insieme a un team forte. Se avete una passione per la leadership e i test ad alta tensione, vi offriamo la fase per portare a cambiamenti reali e modellare attivamente il futuro dei nostri processi produttivi. Guidare il team di laboratorio, compresa la gestione delle risorse e lo sviluppo del team (15 FTE) e agire come punto di contatto per i test HV a Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Assicurarsi il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e qualità (IEC\/IEEE) Analizzare e implementare processi produttivi e aziendali efficienti per aumentare la sicurezza, la qualità e la produttività Garantire un elevato rendimento attraverso procedure di test affidabili ad alta tensione (AC, DC, impulso, scarico parziale) Identificare e integrare nuove tecnologie e best practice per guidare il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP) insieme al vostro team e al nostro team di Process Engineering Collaborare a stretto contatto con la pianificazione, la garanzia della qualità, la logistica, altri diparti di produzione e parti interessate rilevanti per la progettazione e il miglioramento del processo L'apprendistato tecnico e le qualifiche (Bachelor \/ Master) nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica o equivalente Diversi anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership simile (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Conoscenze solide in sistemi di alta tensione, generatori e sistemi di automazione Conoscenza solida della gestione magra, Six Sigma e altri metodi di ottimizzazione dei processi Esperienza dimostrata nei team leader e motivanti di cross-funzionalità Forte capacità di problem solving e un approccio data-driven al processo decisionale combinato con un forte focus sulla sicurezza Eccellente gestione del tempo, comunicazione e capacità organizzative Fluent in tedesco e inglese Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali possono creare un ambiente in cui tutti si sviluppano.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist der Technologieführer bei der Konstruktion und Herstellung von Hochvolt-Transformatorbuchsen. Alle renommierten internationalen Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die in der Stromerzeugung, Übertragung und Verteilung tätig sind, gehören zu unseren Kunden. Wir haben weltweit eine Top-Position in den Hochspannungstransformatorbuchsenbereichen. In dieser sehr verantwortungsvollen und dynamischen Rolle führen Sie unser Laborteam bei MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) und sorgen dafür, dass wir unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit weiter stärken und unsere Schweizer Branche entwickeln, um das globale Marktwachstum im Energiebereich zu erreichen. In dieser wichtigen Rolle werden Sie die effizienten und innovativen Prozesse unserer 3 verschiedenen Labors gemeinsam mit einem starken Team kontinuierlich vorantreiben. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Führungs- und Hochspannungstests haben, bieten wir Ihnen die Bühne, um echte Veränderungen zu bewirken und die Zukunft unserer Produktionsprozesse aktiv zu gestalten. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Führen Sie das Laborteam, einschließlich Ressourcenmanagement und Teamentwicklung (15 FTE) und fungieren als Ansprechpartner für HV-Tests bei Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyse und Implementierung von effizienten Produktions- und Geschäftsprozessen zur Erhöhung der Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität Sicherstellung der hohen Leistung durch zuverlässige Hochvolt-Testverfahren (AC, DC, Impuls, Teilentladung) Identifizieren und integrieren Sie neue Technologien und Best Practices, um den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (CIP) zusammen mit Ihrem Team und unserem Process Engineering-Team eng mit Planung, Qualitätssicherung, Logistik, anderen Produktionsabteilungen und relevanten Stakeholdern für ganzheitliche Prozessgestaltung und Verbesserung verantwortlich zu sein. Ihr Hintergrund Technische Ausbildung und Qualifikation (Bachelor \/ Master) im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Führungsposition (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solides Wissen in Hochspannungssystemen, Generatoren und Automatisierungssystemen Solides Wissen über schlankes Management, Six Sigma und andere Prozessoptimierungsmethoden Bewährte Erfahrung in führenden und motivierenden funktionsübergreifenden Teams Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und ein datengesteuerter Ansatz zur Entscheidungsfindung in Verbindung mit einem starken Fokus auf Sicherheit Hervorragendes Zeitmanagement, Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten fließend Deutsch und Englisch Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est le leader technologique dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs à haute tension. Toutes les entreprises internationales de renom de l'industrie électrique, actives dans la génération de puissance, la transmission et la distribution sont parmi nos clients. Nous avons une position supérieure dans les zones de douille de transformateur haute tension dans le monde entier. Dans ce rôle très responsable et dynamique, vous dirigerez notre équipe de laboratoire à la MICAFIL à Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) et vous assurerez que nous renforçons notre compétitivité et développons notre succursale suisse pour répondre à la croissance du marché mondial de l'énergie. Dans ce rôle important, vous allez continuer à faire avancer les processus efficaces et innovants de nos 3 laboratoires différents avec une équipe forte. Si vous avez une passion pour le leadership et les tests haute tension, nous vous offrons la scène pour apporter un réel changement et façonner activement l'avenir de nos processus de production. Comment faire un impact Diriger l'équipe de laboratoire, y compris la gestion des ressources et le développement de l'équipe (15 ETP) et agir comme point de contact pour les tests HV à Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Assurer le respect des normes de sécurité et de qualité (IEC\/IEEE) Analyser et mettre en oeuvre des processus de production et d'affaires efficaces pour accroître la sécurité, la qualité et la productivité Assurer un rendement élevé grâce à des procédures d'essai fiables à haute tension (AC, DC, impulsion, décharge partielle) Identifier et intégrer les nouvelles technologies et les meilleures pratiques pour piloter le processus d'amélioration continue (CIP) en collaboration avec votre équipe et notre équipe d'ingénierie des processus Collaborer étroitement avec la planification, l'assurance de la qualité, la logistique, d'autres services de production et les intervenants pertinents pour la conception et l'amélioration holistiques des processus Soyez responsable des instructions de travail et de maintenance optimales et d'autres règlements pertinents (p. ex. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Élaborer et surveiller les indicateurs de rendement clés les plus importants (ICP) pour mesurer le succès et le transfert au gestionnaire des opérations En tant que gestionnaire des personnes, vous serez responsable d'assurer le respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables Votre formation Apprentissage technique et qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) dans le domaine du génie électrique ou équivalent Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un poste de leadership similaire (essais à haute tension\/technologie d'isolation\/ingénierie de puissance) Savoir-faire solide dans les systèmes à haute tension, les générateurs et les systèmes d'automatisation Savoir-faire solide en gestion maigre, Six Sigma et autres méthodes d'optimisation des processus Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite et la motivation d'équipes interfonctionnelles Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et une approche de la prise de décision axée sur les données combinée à une forte concentration sur la sécurité Excellente gestion du temps, communication et compétences organisationnelles Fluent en allemand et en anglais Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Praktikant Praxisintegriertes Bachelorstudium (PiBs) Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen 40% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie und gestalte unsere Produktion durch datengetriebene Prozessoptimierung aktiv mit. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium – etwa aus Methoden- und Projektmanagement – direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Automatisiere Geschäftsprozesse mit Power BI, Power Automate oder Power Platform Betreue und begleite sowohl bestehende als auch neue Projekte Arbeite mit Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) und Datenbanken Erstelle Prozessabläufe nach BPMN 2.0 und treibe die Digitalisierung (Process Mining, Citizen Development und Businessanalysen) voran Verbinde technisches Know-how mit betriebswirtschaftlichem Denken und setze die Theorie in Praxis um (Requirement Engineering) Lerne bei uns wie man verschiedene Anspruchsgruppen abholt um erfolgreich Wirkung zu erzielen (Change Management) Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Gymnasiale Matura (Voraussetzungen für die Zulassung an der Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Offenheit, Proaktivität und Selbstmotivation Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise Fliessendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), Kenntnisse in Englisch (B1) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Inizia la tua carriera con un ingresso pratico nel settore e modella attivamente la nostra produzione attraverso l'ottimizzazione dei processi data-driven. Stai implementando le tue conoscenze teoriche dai tuoi studi – ad esempio dal metodo e dalla gestione dei progetti – direttamente nella pratica e ottieni un'esperienza preziosa.
• Vi offriamo un ambiente che vi dà sicurezza e fiducia in se stessi per la vostra carriera. Condizioni di lavoro flessibili e un team di supporto dedicato vi accompagnerà sulla vostra strada per la laurea di successo. Nota: Lo stage è possibile esclusivamente in combinazione con un corso di laurea integrato nella pratica presso l'Università di Scienze Applicate della Svizzera nordoccidentale FHNW \/ Zurigo University of Applied Sciences ZHAW. Ulteriori informazioni possono essere trovate qui: Link a FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studie\/technik\/pibs Link a ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studie\/bachelorstudie\/praxis-integrate-bachelorstudie Questo consente di gestire con successo i processi aziendali automatizzati con Power BI, Power Automate o Power Platform e di accompagnare i progetti esistenti e nuovi con Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) e database Crea sequenze di processo secondo BPMN 2.0 e digitalizzazione del disco (process mining, Citizen development and business analysis) per far progredire il know-how tecnico con il business thinking e implementare la teoria in pratica (ingegneria dei requisiti) Questo è ciò che si porta con Gymnasiale Matura completata (provvedimenti per l'ammissione alla Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Apertura, proattività e auto-motivazione Capacità di comunicazione goffrata e competenze sociali per metodi di lavoro indipendenti e strutturati Tedesco completo (almeno C1), conoscenza in inglese (B1) Ulteriori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a combinare obiettivi personali e professionali.
• Vi offriamo un ambiente in cui potete sviluppare e coltivare le vostre competenze – supportate da mentoring e da una cultura inclusiva. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra domanda, compreso CV, lettera di motivazione e certificati.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Start your career with a practical entry into the industry and actively shape our production by data-driven process optimization. You are implementing your theoretical knowledge from your studies – for example from method and project management – directly into practice and gain valuable experience.
• We offer you an environment that gives you security and self-confidence for your career. Flexible working conditions and a dedicated, supportive team will accompany you on your way to the successful Bachelor's degree. Note: The internship is exclusively possible in combination with a practice-integrated bachelor's degree programme at the University of Applied Sciences Northwestern Switzerland FHNW \/ Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW. Further information can be found here: Link to FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studie\/technik\/pibs Link to ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studie\/bachelorstudie\/praxis-integrated-bachelorstudie\/ This allows you to successfully manage automated business processes with Power BI, Power Automate or Power Platform and accompany both existing and new projects work with Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) and databases Create process sequences according to BPMN 2.0 and drive digitization (process mining, Citizen development and business analysis) to advance technical know-how with business thinking and implement the theory in practice (requirement engineering) This is what you bring with completed Gymnasiale Matura (provisions for admission to the Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Openness, proactivity and self-motivation Embossed communication skills and social competence capability for independent and structured working methods Complete German (at least C1), knowledge in English (B1) More about us Our flexible work practices help you combine personal and professional goals.
• We offer you an environment where you can develop and grow your skills – supported by mentoring and an inclusive culture. Did we awaken your interest? Then we look forward to your application including CV, letter of motivation and certificates.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy High Tensione Products è lo specialista di fama mondiale per la trasmissione di energia e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita mondiale dei sistemi di commutazione di protezione del generatore (GCB) e dei sistemi di interruttori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi aggiuntivi, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, conversioni e scambi. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza mondiale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, sarà in esecuzione installazioni e manutenzione in tutto il mondo GIS. Un luogo tecnicamente impegnativo vi aspetta in un ambiente multiculturale. Questo consente di gestire siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per sistemi di commutazione isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV – 550KV Competenze per l'esecuzione di successo dell'installazione, manutenzione e riparazione in loco, nel rispetto delle date contrattuali e tenendo conto dei requisiti legali locali Responsabile per la qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo di qualità e la valutazione delle capacità del personale di aiuto locale che eseguono la formazione dei prodotti in loco al prodotto e durante l'installazione Efficienza e guida dei lavoratori Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare al progetto di gestione
• Compiti con un sacco di spazio di progettazione Possibilità interessanti per un'ulteriore formazione e sviluppo personale Attività interessanti e diversificate\/progetti – anche con incarichi stranieri Gruppo integrato e dinamico Cultura aziendale aperta Pacchetto di prestazioni attraente tra cui remunerazione fissa, costi di viaggio e catering e partecipazione alla scelta di alloggi
descriptionByLocale.en:
Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products is the world-renowned specialist for energy transmission and energy distribution. The service unit is responsible for the worldwide after-sales support of generator protection switch systems (GCB) and gas-insulated switchgear systems (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, additional services, troubleshooting, extensions, conversions and exchanges. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our worldwide service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practical training in Switzerland and abroad, you will be running installations and maintenance around the GIS globe. A technically challenging place awaits you in a multicultural environment. This allows you to manage multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas-insulated switching systems for the voltage level of 110KV – 550KV Responsible for the successful execution of the on-site installation, maintenance and repairs while complying with contractual dates and taking into account local legal requirements Responsible for the quality of the work carried out on site by means of quality control and assessment of the capabilities of local aid staff performing product training on site at the product and during installation Efficiency and guidance of workers Cost control of the resources used and regular reporting to the project management Active cooperation in process improvements and proactive intervention of measures to increase efficiency on site Your background Complete teaching in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry Basic knowledge of electrical engineering are a must, electrotechnical training of minimum 5 years professional experience in assembly and commissioning areas High German and good English skills
• Tasks with a lot of design space Attractive possibilities for further education and personal development Interesting and diverse activities\/projects – also with foreign assignments Built-in and dynamic team Open corporate culture Attractive performance package including fixed remuneration, travel and catering costs as well as participation in the choice of accommodation

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di ingegnere del servizio sul campo presso HITACHI ENERGY LTD siete responsabili per l'installazione, la manutenzione e la riparazione dei nostri prodotti e sistemi direttamente al cliente in Svizzera. Garantisci le prestazioni e la disponibilità ottimali dell'attrezzatura e contribuisci in modo significativo alla soddisfazione dei nostri clienti. È possibile eseguire installazioni, messa in servizio, manutenzione e riparazioni su prodotti e sistemi HITACHI ENERGY, soprattutto nelle aree di alta tensione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Analisi degli errori e eliminazione di sistemi e sistemi elettrici complessi. Creazione di rapporti di servizio e documentazione dopo ogni applicazione. Consulenza clienti per domande tecniche e opzioni di ottimizzazione. Formazione del personale del cliente nella gestione dei sistemi. Rispetto alle normative di sicurezza e agli standard di qualità. Pronto a viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente all'estero. Partecipazione ai servizi di standby al di fuori delle ore di lavoro regolari. Formazione continua e aggiornamento delle competenze sui nuovi prodotti e tecnologie. Formazione tecnica completa (ad esempio elettricista, elettronico, automatico) o studi (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia energetica). Esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore del servizio o della manutenzione di impianti elettrici, idealmente nel settore dell'energia. La conoscenza della tecnologia ad alta tensione, sistemi di commutazione e sistemi di controllo è vantaggiosa. Gestione sicura delle apparecchiature di misura e di prova. Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura (swiss tedesco di vantaggio), così come buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza francese è un vantaggio. Capacità di problem solving goffrato e pensiero analitico. Alto livello di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento del cliente. Valido ID Categoria B del conducente. Volontà a orari di lavoro flessibili e attività di viaggio. Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
• Offriamo emozionante e variegato
• Compiti con un ampio spazio di progettazione e interessanti possibilità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e versatili, tra cui operazioni offshore, un team consolidato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre, si beneficia di un pacchetto attraente di servizi con viaggi fissi e pacchetti di catering, nonché un diritto di parlare quando si sceglie l'alloggio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the equipment and make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers. You can do this by performing installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs on HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution. Error analysis and elimination of complex electrical systems and systems. Creation of service reports and documentation after each application. Customer advice regarding technical questions and optimization options. Training of customer personnel in handling the systems. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Ready to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in standby services outside regular working hours. Continuous training and updating the expertise on new products and technologies. Your background Complete technical training (e.g. electrician, electronic, automatic) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy technology). Multiannual professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical installations, ideally in the energy industry. Knowledge of high-voltage technology, switching systems and control systems is advantageous. Safe handling of measuring and testing equipment. Good knowledge of German in word and writing (swiss German of advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. French knowledge is a plus. Embossed problem solving capabilities and analytical thinking. High level of initiative, sense of responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driver's ID Category B. Willing to flexible working hours and travel activities. More about us
• We offer exciting and varied
• Tasks with a large design space and attractive training and development possibilities. You can expect interesting and versatile activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive package of services with fixed travel and catering packages as well as a right to speak when choosing accommodation.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Hitachi Energy, il nostro scopo è quello di promuovere un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. jobs.title: Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems - Europe
jobs.description: The Opportunity As the Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, performance, and growth of our Substation Automation portfolio across the region. You will oversee all commercial, operational, and technical aspects of the HUB, ensuring excellence in project execution, customer satisfaction, and business results. This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

descriptionByLocale.en: The Opportunity As the Operating Unit Manager for Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, performance, and growth of our Substation Automation portfolio across the region. You will oversee all commercial, operational, and technical aspects of the HUB, ensuring excellence in project execution, customer satisfaction, and business results. This role reports to the HUB Leader and collaborates closely with global Product Management, R&D, and cross‑regional teams. Location is flexible within Europe and will be confirmed during later stages. This role requires frequent travel within Europe and occasional international travel. How You'll Make an Impact Drive Strategic Direction & Business Growth: Develop and execute the HUB's strategy in alignment with global objectives. Identify market opportunities, expand customer relationships, and grow sales in substation automation solutions including protection relays, SCADA, control systems, and communication technologies. Lead Operational Excellence: Oversee engineering, project delivery, sales support, and service execution. Define and track KPIs to secure efficient operations, on‑time delivery, customer satisfaction, and strong financial performance. Strengthen Customer & Market Presence: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, and stakeholders across Europe. Represent Hitachi Energy as a subject matter expert at industry forums and customer engagements. Ensure Financial Performance: Manage budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability targets. Identify improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce cost. Advance Technical Expertise & Innovation: Stay at the forefront of substation automation technologies, industry trends, competitor movements, and regulatory changes. Promote innovation and technology adoption across the HUB. Champion Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure operations comply with internal policies, industry standards, and European regulations. Promote a strong safety and quality culture across all teams and activities. Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with global product management, R&D, and other regional business units to share best practices, align strategies, and maximize value from the full Hitachi Energy portfolio. Lead & Develop High‑Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and empower a strong team of engineers, project managers, and commercial professionals. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in the power transmission and distribution industry, with deep expertise in substation automation systems, of which 5–7 years in a leadership role managing a business unit, department, or similar organization within a multinational environment. Strong technical knowledge across substation automation architectures, protective relaying, SCADA, control systems, IEC 61850, and cybersecurity for critical infrastructure. Proven success in business strategy execution, P&L management, contract negotiation, and complex project delivery and strong understanding of the European energy market, customer landscape, and regulatory environment. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence across a matrix environment. Fluency in English is required; additional European languages are an asset.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire d'unité d'exploitation de Substation Automation Systems HUB Europe, vous jouerez un rôle de premier plan dans l'orientation stratégique, la performance et la croissance de notre portefeuille de Substation Automation dans toute la région. Vous superviserez tous les aspects commerciaux, opérationnels et techniques du HUB, assurant l'excellence dans l'exécution des projets, la satisfaction des clients et les résultats commerciaux. Ce rôle relève du chef de la DGPS et collabore étroitement avec les équipes mondiales de gestion des produits, de R-D et d'autres régions. L'emplacement est flexible en Europe et sera confirmé au cours des étapes ultérieures. Ce rôle exige des voyages fréquents en Europe et des voyages internationaux occasionnels. Comment vous ferez un impact Conduire l'orientation stratégique et la croissance des entreprises: Développer et exécuter la stratégie de la HUB en harmonie avec les objectifs globaux. Identifier les débouchés commerciaux, élargir les relations avec les clients et accroître les ventes dans les solutions d'automatisation des sous-stations, y compris les relais de protection, SCADA, les systèmes de contrôle et les technologies de communication. Excellence opérationnelle principale : Superviser l'ingénierie, la réalisation de projets, le soutien aux ventes et l'exécution des services. Définir et suivre les ICR pour assurer l'efficacité des opérations, la livraison dans les délais, la satisfaction de la clientèle et une bonne performance financière. Renforcer la présence du client et du marché : établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients, partenaires et parties prenantes en Europe. Représenter Hitachi Energy en tant qu'expert dans les forums de l'industrie et les engagements des clients. Assurer le rendement financier : Gérer les budgets, les prévisions et l'affectation des ressources pour atteindre les objectifs de recettes, de marge et de rentabilité. Déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration pour accroître l'efficience et réduire les coûts. Expertise technique et innovation avancées : restez à l'avant-garde des technologies d'automatisation des sous-stations, des tendances de l'industrie, des mouvements de concurrents et des changements réglementaires. Promouvoir l'innovation et l'adoption de technologies dans l'ensemble du HUB. Champion Qualité, Sécurité et Conformité: Veiller à ce que les opérations soient conformes aux politiques internes, aux normes de l'industrie et aux réglementations européennes. Promouvoir une solide culture de sécurité et de qualité dans toutes les équipes et activités. Collaborer à l'échelle des fonctions : S'associer à la gestion des produits à l'échelle mondiale, à la R-D et à d'autres unités opérationnelles régionales pour partager les meilleures pratiques, harmoniser les stratégies et maximiser la valeur du portefeuille complet d'Hitachi Energy. Dirigez et développez des équipes à haut rendement : recrutez, mentorez et autonomisez une solide équipe d'ingénieurs, de gestionnaires de projets et de professionnels du commerce. Favoriser une culture de collaboration, d'apprentissage continu et d'excellence opérationnelle. Votre baccalauréat en génie électrique, en génie d'automatisation ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un MBA est un avantage. 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie du transport et de la distribution d'électricité, avec une expertise approfondie dans les systèmes d'automatisation des sous-stations, dont 5 à 7 ans dans un rôle de leadership de gestion d'une unité commerciale, d'un département ou d'une organisation similaire dans un environnement multinational. Forte connaissance technique des architectures d'automatisation des sous-stations, relais de protection, SCADA, systèmes de contrôle, CEI 61850 et cybersécurité pour les infrastructures essentielles. Succès prouvé dans l'exécution de la stratégie commerciale, la gestion de la P&L, la négociation de contrats, la réalisation de projets complexes et une bonne compréhension du marché européen de l'énergie, du paysage client et de l'environnement réglementaire. Excellent leadership, communication et compétences en gestion des intervenants avec la capacité d'influencer dans un environnement matriciel. La maîtrise de l'anglais est nécessaire; d'autres langues européennes sont un atout.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Start-Up Engineering Experienced Professional (f/m/d) 80 - 100%
jobs.description:
The opportunity In this role, you will plan, prepare, and coordinate all pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and start‑up activities through to successful handover. You will develop and maintain commissioning plans, schedules, manuals, test procedures, and documentation, ensuring all activities meet customer, quality, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with engineering, project management, and third‑party partners to resolve technical issues, obtain required approvals, and secure customer acceptance. Working independently, you will apply your technical expertise to drive safe, efficient, and compliant commissioning execution while contributing to continuous improvement and supporting the wider project team. How you'll make an impact
• Carry out testing and commissioning of control and relay panels and substation automation systems across various locations in Singapore
• Execute commissioning activities safely in line with Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards, reporting hazards and near misses
• Ensure a positive customer experience and manage customer relationships professionally
• Perform commissioning according to documented processes and checklists, resolving open points and securing customer sign‑off
• Report site progress and planning and ensure efficient use of commissioning assets such as test kits and tools
• Hand over marked‑up drawings for as‑built preparation and final submission to the customer
• Identify and monitor risks in your area of responsibility, ensuring stakeholders remain informed
• Provide guidance to associate commissioning engineers and coordinate tasks with junior staff or small Your background
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field
• Several years of hands‑on experience in commissioning protection, control, or substation automation systems
• Solid knowledge of protection relays, substation communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850), and related testing tools
• Strong understanding of safety standards and compliance requirements in utility or industrial environments
• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation
• Ability to interact confidently with customers, engineers, project managers, and external stakeholders
• Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work independently at customer sites More about us At Hitachi Energy, diversity and collaboration are central to how we work. We believe that bringing together different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas strengthens our teams and drives innovation. You will join a global environment where people support each other, learn from one another, and work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

Die Gelegenheit In dieser Rolle planen, bereiten und koordinieren Sie alle Vor-, Inbetriebnahme- und Start-up-Aktivitäten bis hin zur erfolgreichen Übergabe. • Stellen Sie ein positives Kundenerlebnis sicher und verwalten Sie Kundenbeziehungen professionell
• Inbetriebnahme nach dokumentierten Prozessen und Checklisten, Auflösen von offenen Punkten und Absicherung des Kunden
• Stellenfortschritt und -planung melden und einen effizienten Einsatz von Kommissioniervermögen wie Testkits und Tools sicherstellen
• Hand über markierte Zeichnungen für as‐built Vorbereitung und endgültige Einreichung des Kunden
• Risiken in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich identifizieren und überwachen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Interessenvertreter weiterhin informiert bleiben
• Stellen Sie Anleitung, um die Inbetriebsetzung von Ingenieuren zu verbinden und Aufgaben mit Junior-Personal oder klein zu koordinieren
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Power Engineering oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich
• Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme von Schutz-, Steuerungs- oder Umladeautomatisierungssystemen
• Solides Wissen über Schutzrelais, Unterstations-Kommunikationsprotokolle (z.B. IEC 61850) und zugehörige Testwerkzeuge
• Starkes Verständnis von Sicherheitsstandards und Compliance-Anforderungen in Arbeits- oder Industrieumgebungen
• Erleben Sie technische Zeichnungen, Schaltpläne und technische Dokumentation

• Starke Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, selbständig an Kundenstandorten zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy sind Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit von zentraler Bedeutung, wie wir arbeiten. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous planifierez, préparerez et coordonnerez toutes les activités préalables à la mise en service, à la mise en service et au démarrage, jusqu'à la passation réussie. Vous élaborerez et conserverez des plans de mise en service, des calendriers, des manuels, des procédures d'essai et de la documentation, en veillant à ce que toutes les activités répondent aux exigences de la clientèle, de la qualité et de la réglementation. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie, la gestion de projet et des partenaires tiers pour résoudre les problèmes techniques, obtenir les approbations requises et assurer l'acceptation des clients. Travaillant de manière indépendante, vous appliquerez votre expertise technique pour conduire une exécution de mise en service sûre, efficace et conforme tout en contribuant à l'amélioration continue et en soutenant l'équipe de projet élargie. Comment vous ferez un impact
• Effectuer des essais et la mise en service de panneaux de commande et de relais et de systèmes d'automatisation des sous-stations sur différents sites de Singapour
• Exécuter des activités de mise en service en toute sécurité conformément aux normes Hitachi Energy et de sécurité des clients, signaler les risques et les quasi-pertes
• Assurer une expérience client positive et gérer les relations client professionnellement
• Effectuer la mise en service selon des processus documentés et des listes de contrôle, résoudre des points ouverts et garantir l'approbation du client
• Faire rapport sur l'état d'avancement et la planification du site et veiller à l'utilisation efficace des moyens de mise en service tels que les trousses d'essai et les outils
• Remise de dessins marqués pour la préparation et la soumission finale au client
• Identifier et surveiller les risques dans votre domaine de responsabilité, en veillant à ce que les parties prenantes restent informées
• Fournir des conseils aux ingénieurs de mise en service associés et coordonner les tâches avec le personnel subalterne ou petit Votre expérience
• Baccalauréat en génie électrique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique connexe
• Plusieurs années d'expérience pratique dans la mise en service de systèmes d'automatisation de protection, de contrôle ou de sous-station
• Connaissance approfondie des relais de protection, des protocoles de communication sous-station (par exemple CEI 61850) et des outils d'essai connexes
• Une bonne compréhension des normes de sécurité et des exigences de conformité dans les environnements d'utilité ou industriels
• Expérience d'interprétation de dessins techniques, de schémas et de documentation technique
• Capacité d'interagir en toute confiance avec les clients, les ingénieurs, les gestionnaires de projet et les intervenants externes
• Des compétences solides en résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante sur les sites clients Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Énergie, la diversité et la collaboration sont au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Nous croyons que le regroupement de différents horizons, perspectives et idées renforce nos équipes et stimule l'innovation. Vous vous joindrez à un environnement mondial où les gens se soutiennent, apprennent les uns des autres et travaillent ensemble pour faire progresser un avenir énergétique durable pour tous.

Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage priorities and drive timely execution. Experience in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements and maintain KPIs

How you'll make an impact You are a leader : Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting your team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology You are impactful: Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative and motivating working environment You foster collaboration: Maintain and extend an excellent network to relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration between all Hitachi Energy Research Centers You contribute: Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, covering electrical emergency first aider role (Training will be provided) Oversee different research laboratories, including safety Your background PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in following areas: circuit breaker, high power testing, plasma physics, and an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and proven track record in industrial R&D, with relevant people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); proficiency in German is an advantage If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

jobs.title: Business Analyst Global Product Group DT
jobs.description: The Opportunity: As a part of Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers team, you will be responsible for business analysis for core digitalization projects including Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA and Matterport within 25 factories in the portfolio scope. You will contribute cross-functionally by collaborating with IT function and business domains, as well as being responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the GPG DT Power BI reports to monitor KPIs and performance metrics How you'll make an impact Ensure adherence to data governance standards and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports and processes within GPG DT Operations Digital area. Collect and design business requirements into required documentation format and templates. Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes, tools, and methodologies for greater efficiency and scalability. Implement best practices and leverage emerging technologies to improve data analytics capabilities. Provide training and guidance to business teams on the analytics reports, core digital tools, TrafoSignature tool. Collaborate with global teams, HUBs, and factories to gather requirements and deliver tailored reporting solutions. Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency. Lead functional and business analysis for core projects: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport from business perspective. Perform user acceptance tests and validation together with key-users and IT. Provide digital updates on GPG DT website content with the usage of CMS.   Your background Degree in Engineering, Data Science, IT or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of experience in end-to-end data analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments. Proficiency in Power BI, including advanced DAX functions, Power Query, and report scheduling. Good knowledge of data modeling, visualization, and integration from multiple sources (e.g., SAP, SQL, Azure, Power Automate). Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with global technical teams and stakeholders. Strong understanding of functional and business analysis. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a global team environment. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully .* * A pplicable   only for Poland location align with local law regulations

jobs.title: Project Control Engineer for Power Converters 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Praktikant Praxisintegriertes Bachelorstudium (PiBS) Maschinenbau und Elektrotechnik 40% (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hitachi Energy bietet Dir interessante 
• Aufgaben in einem hoch motivierten Engineering Team im Bereich Technical Project Engineering. Hier beschäftigst Du dich mit dem Design und Abwickeln von Umrichter-Systemen in den Bereichen Power Quality (STATCOM), Bahnnetzkupplungen, Netzkupplungen und Pumpspeicheranlagen. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung des Engineering Teams bei der Realisierung von Kundenprojekten während der Abwicklungsphase  Erstellung von Zeichnungen \/ Schemata \/ 3D-Modellen, die den individuellen 
• Anforderungen der Kunden entsprechen Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption innovativer, kundenorientierter Lösungen  Anlegen und Pflegen von Stücklisten \/ Materialien im ERP-System SAP Pflege von Zeichnungen \/ Schemata \/ und Dokumenten im Dokumenten Management System (DMS) Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Gymnasiale Matura (Voraussetzungen für die Zulassung an der Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Interesse an Technik und Energiesystemen und Freude am Arbeiten in interdisziplinären Teams Gute Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office und Affinität zu CAD Tools Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise  sowie Bereitschaft zur eigenen kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung Fliessendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), Kenntnisse in Englisch (B2) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. 
• Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.

jobs.title: GPG Engineering standardization expert
jobs.description: The opportunity The GPG Standardization Lead will be responsible for defining and driving the standardization strategy across the Global Product Group (GPG). The GPG Standardization Lead will work closely with various business units, engineering teams, and supply chain departments to ensure the efficient implementation of standardization practices, which are critical to enhancing material availability, speeding up procurement processes, and leveraging economies of scale in a rapidly growing market. How you'll make an impact Develop and drive a comprehensive standardization strategy at the GPG level, in collaboration with business unit (BU) and regional HUBs. Ensure the strategy aligns with organizational goals and market demands. Enhance the standardization of parts by quantifying standardization and associated costs. Define criteria for standardization and criteria for new part creation in collaboration with engineering and supply chain teams Develop visual dashboards for engineering metrics such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacity, quality, metrics Drive development of search tools, to improve reuse of existing parts and components; drive implementation in design platform of features related to standardization Create and maintain a specification and rules library based on customer profiles to drive standardization among factories. Agree on which items from PLM (windchill) to connect to design tools. Establish methods for quantifying, measuring, and improving standardization practices. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's \/ Master's degree in Engineering is preferred. Minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering with a focus on standardization. Proven track record in developing and implementing standardization strategies. Strong understanding of procurement processes and material management. Experience with engineering dashboards and metrics. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strategic thinking and planning. Familiarity with PLM software (PTC Windchill is preferred) Proficiency in standardization principles and practices. Knowledge of Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and other engineering metrics. Familiarity with GMR\/Windchill and other design tools. Strong organizational and project management skills. Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità The GPG Standardization Lead sarà responsabile della definizione e della guida della strategia di standardizzazione in tutto il Global Product Group (GPG). Il GPG Standardization Lead lavorerà a stretto contatto con diverse unità di business, team di ingegneria e dipartimenti della supply chain per garantire l'implementazione efficiente delle pratiche di standardizzazione, che sono fondamentali per migliorare la disponibilità dei materiali, accelerare i processi di approvvigionamento e sfruttare le economie di scala in un mercato in rapida crescita. Sviluppare e guidare una strategia di standardizzazione completa a livello GPG, in collaborazione con business unit (BU) e HUB regionali. Assicurarsi che la strategia si allinei con obiettivi organizzativi e richieste di mercato. Migliorare la standardizzazione delle parti, quantificare la standardizzazione e i costi associati. Definire i criteri per la standardizzazione e i criteri per la creazione di nuove parti in collaborazione con team di ingegneria e supply chain Sviluppare dashboard visivi per metriche di ingegneria come Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacità, qualità, metriche Sviluppo di strumenti di ricerca, per migliorare il riutilizzo di parti e componenti esistenti; implementare la piattaforma di progettazione di funzionalità relative alla standardizzazione Creare e mantenere una libreria di specifiche e regole basata sui profili dei clienti per guidare la standardizzazione tra le fabbriche. Accetto su quali elementi da PLM (windchill) per connettersi a strumenti di progettazione. Stabilire metodi per quantificare, misurare e migliorare le pratiche di standardizzazione. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali di Hitachi Energy di sicurezza e integrità, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità per le proprie azioni, mentre la cura per i vostri colleghi e il business Il vostro background Bachelor \ / Master in Ingegneria è preferito. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in ingegneria con un focus sulla standardizzazione. Provato record di traccia nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di standardizzazione. Forte comprensione dei processi di approvvigionamento e della gestione dei materiali. Esperienza con dashboard di ingegneria e metriche. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione per lavorare con team interfunzionali. Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving. Il pensiero strategico e la pianificazione. Familiarità con il software PLM (PTC Windchill è preferito) La competenza nei principi e nelle pratiche di standardizzazione. Conoscenza della mappatura del flusso di valore (VSM) e altre metriche di ingegneria. Familiarità con GMR\/Windchill e altri strumenti di progettazione. Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto. È richiesta la competenza in lingua inglese parlata e scritta
